  PROCEDURE P_GET_POSITION_AUDITBRANCH(io_cursor     OUT t_cursor,
                                       p_AuditZoneId in number,
                                       p_ZoneID      in number,
                                       p_AuditPeriod in number,
                                       p_AsOnDate    in date,
                                       p_UptoDate    in date) IS
  BEGIN
    OPEN io_cursor FOR
      select trim(to_char(ap.start_date, 'dd-MM-yyyy') || ' TO ' ||
                  to_char(ap.end_date, 'dd-MM-yyyy') || ' ' ||
                  ap.description) PeriodDescr,
             p.auditby_id,
             az.zonename AZoneName,
             z.ZONEID,
             z.ZONENAME,
             
             sum((case
                   when ap.status_id = '1' and p.status > 4 /*and p.audit_startdate <= p_UptoDate*/
                    then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end)) SpecialAuditCompleted,
             sum((case
                   when ap.status_id = '1' and p.status > 4 /*and p.audit_startdate <= p_UptoDate*/
                    then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end)) NormalAuditCompleted,
             sum((case
                   when p.status >= 4 and p.status < 5 /*and p.audit_startdate <= p_UptoDate*/
                    then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end)) InProgress,
             sum((case
                   when p.status <= 3 and p.audit_startdate <= p_UptoDate then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end)) ToBeAudited,
             count(*) TotalBranches
        from t_au_plan_eng p
      /* inner join v_service_department d on p.audit_conductby_dept = d.id*/
       inner join t_au_period ap
          on p.period_id = ap.auditperiodid
      /*inner join t_status s on p.status = s.statusid*/
        left outer join v_service_branch b
          on p.entity_code = b.BRANCHID
        left outer join v_SERVICE_ZONES z
          on b.ZONEID = z.ZONEID
        left outer join v_service_auditzone az
          on p.auditby_id = az.id
      
       where p.auditby_id = 128
         and auditby_id =
             decode(p_AuditZoneId, 0, auditby_id, p_AuditZoneId)
         and z.ZONEID = decode(p_ZoneID, 0, z.zoneid, p_ZoneID)
         and p.period_id =
             decode(p_AuditPeriod, 0, p.period_id, p_AuditPeriod)
         and (to_char(p.audit_startdate, 'YYYY')) =
             TO_CHAR(p_UptoDate, 'YYYY')
      
       group by trim(to_char(ap.start_date, 'dd-MM-yyyy') || ' TO ' ||
                     to_char(ap.end_date, 'dd-MM-yyyy') || ' ' ||
                     ap.description),
                p.auditby_id,
                z.ZONENAME,
                z.ZONEID,
                az.zonename;
  END P_GET_POSITION_AUDITBRANCH;

  PROCEDURE R_Audit_Plan_Engagement(Audit_Period in number,
                                    auditbyid    in number,
                                    io_cursor    OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
  
    Open io_cursor for
      select p.description        as auditperiod,
             mp.p_name            as Parent_Office,
             ee.name              as Enitiy_name,
             e.audit_startdate,
             e.audit_enddate,
             e.travel_day,
             e.revenue_record_day,
             e.discussion_day,
             tm.team_name,
             tm.member_name,
             s.status
        from t_au_plan_eng e
       inner join t_au_plan_eng_status s
          on e.status = s.id
       inner join t_auditee_entities ee
          on ee.entity_id = e.entity_id
        left join t_auditee_entities_maping mp
          on mp.entity_id = e.auditby_id
       inner join t_au_period p
          on p.auditperiodid = e.period_id
       inner join t_au_team_members tm
          on tm.t_id = e.team_id
         and tm.isteamlead = 'Y'
       where p.auditperiodid = Audit_Period
         and mp.parent_id = auditbyid
       order by e.audit_startdate;
  end R_Audit_Plan_Engagement;

  PROCEDURE R_functionalresp(cid       in number,
                             sid       in number,
                             cdid      in number,
                             io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    if (cdid != 0) then
      OPEN io_Cursor FOR
        select s.audit_period  as PERIOD,
               s.entity_name,
               c.heading       as PROCESS,
               sb.heading      as SUB_PROCESS,
               t.heading       as VIOLATION,
               s.gist_of_paras as OBS_TEXT,
               r.description   as OBS_RISK,
               t.status        as OBS_STATUS
          from t_audit_checklist_details t
         inner join t_audit_checklist_sub p
            on p.s_id = t.s_id
         inner join t_au_old_paras_fad s
            on s.process_detail = t.id
         inner join t_audit_checklist_sub sb
            on sb.s_id = t.s_id
         inner join t_audit_checklist c
            on c.t_id = sb.t_id
         inner join t_risk r
            on r.r_id = t.risk_id
           and s.process_detail = cdid
         order by t.id asc;
    
    else
      if (sid != 0) then
        OPEN io_Cursor FOR
          select s.audit_period  as PERIOD,
                 s.entity_name,
                 c.heading       as PROCESS,
                 sb.heading      as SUB_PROCESS,
                 t.heading       as VIOLATION,
                 s.gist_of_paras as OBS_TEXT,
                 r.description   as OBS_RISK,
                 t.status        as OBS_STATUS
            from t_audit_checklist_details t
           inner join t_audit_checklist_sub p
              on p.s_id = t.s_id
           inner join t_au_old_paras_fad s
              on s.process_detail = t.id
           inner join t_audit_checklist_sub sb
              on sb.s_id = t.s_id
           inner join t_audit_checklist c
              on c.t_id = sb.t_id
           inner join t_risk r
              on r.r_id = t.risk_id
           where sb.s_id = sid
           order by t.id asc;
      
      else
        if (cdid != 0) then
          OPEN io_Cursor FOR
            select s.audit_period  as PERIOD,
                   s.entity_name,
                   c.heading       as PROCESS,
                   sb.heading      as SUB_PROCESS,
                   t.heading       as VIOLATION,
                   s.gist_of_paras as OBS_TEXT,
                   r.description   as OBS_RISK,
                   t.status        as OBS_STATUS
              from t_audit_checklist_details t
             inner join t_audit_checklist_sub p
                on p.s_id = t.s_id
             inner join t_au_old_paras_fad s
                on s.process_detail = t.id
             inner join t_audit_checklist_sub sb
                on sb.s_id = t.s_id
             inner join t_audit_checklist c
                on c.t_id = sb.t_id
             inner join t_risk r
                on r.r_id = t.risk_id
             where c.t_id = cid
             order by t.id asc;
        
        end if;
      end if;
    end if;
  end R_functionalresp;

  PROCEDURE R_joiningcompletion(Dept_id     IN NUMBER,
                                Audit_start IN DATE,
                                Audit_end   IN DATE,
                                io_cursor   OUT t_cursor) IS
  BEGIN
    OPEN io_cursor FOR
      SELECT dpt.deptname       AS audit_by,
             e.p_name           as Reporting,
             e.child_code      as code,
             e.c_name           AS auditee_name,
             r.description      AS Risk,
             ep.audit_startdate AS Start_date,
             ep.audit_enddate   AS End_date,
             st.status          AS status,
             ep.lastupdateddate AS issuance_date      
        FROM t_au_plan_eng ep
        inner join t_auditee_entities ee
        on ee.entity_id = ep.entity_id
       INNER JOIN t_auditee_entities_maping e
          ON e.entity_id = ep.entity_id
       inner join t_au_plan_eng_status st
          on st.id = ep.status
       INNER JOIN t_risk r
          ON r.rating = ee.risk_id
       INNER JOIN t_audit_departments dpt
          ON dpt.entity_id = ep.auditby_id
       inner JOIN t_auditee_entities_maping dem
          ON dem.entity_id = ep.auditby_id
       WHERE ((Dept_id = 112243 AND dem.parent_id = Dept_id) OR
             (Dept_id <> 112243 AND dem.entity_id = Dept_id))
         AND TRUNC(ep.audit_startdate) >= TRUNC(Audit_start)
         AND TRUNC(ep.audit_enddate) <= TRUNC(Audit_end)      
       ORDER BY ep.auditby_id, ep.audit_startdate;
       
  END R_joiningcompletion;

  procedure R_AuditPlanProgress(Dept_id in number, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select mp.entity_id,
             mp.name AS auditname,
             count(DISTINCT p.id) AS AUDITS,
             count(DISTINCT ep.eng_id) AS engplan,
             count(distinct j.eng_plan_id) as joining,
             count(distinct ep.eng_id) as completed,
             (select count(ob.id)
                from t_au_observation ob
               inner join t_au_plan_eng epg
                  on epg.eng_id = ob.engplanid
                 and epg.entity_id = ob.entity_id
                 and epg.period_id = 2
                 and epg.auditby_id = mp.entity_id) as observations,
             (select count(ob.id)
                from t_au_observation ob
               inner join t_au_plan_eng epg
                  on epg.eng_id = ob.engplanid
                 and epg.entity_id = ob.entity_id
                 and ob.severity = 1
                 and epg.period_id = 2
                 and epg.auditby_id = mp.entity_id) as HighRiskPara,
             (select count(ob.id)
                from t_au_observation ob
               inner join t_au_plan_eng epg
                  on epg.eng_id = ob.engplanid
                 and epg.entity_id = ob.entity_id
                 and ob.severity = 2
                 and epg.period_id = 2
                 and epg.auditby_id = mp.entity_id) as MediumRiskPara,
             (select count(ob.id)
                from t_au_observation ob
               inner join t_au_plan_eng epg
                  on epg.eng_id = ob.engplanid
                 and epg.entity_id = ob.entity_id
                 and ob.severity = 3
                 and epg.period_id = 2
                 and epg.auditby_id = mp.entity_id) as LowRiskPara
        from t_au_plan p
       inner join t_auditee_entities mp
          on mp.entity_id = p.auditedby
         AND P.AUDITPERIODID = 2
        left join t_au_plan_eng ep
          on p.entity_id = ep.entity_id
         and ep.period_id = p.auditperiodid
         and ep.plan_id = p.id
        LEFT join t_au_audit_joining j
          on j.eng_plan_id = ep.eng_id
        LEFT join t_au_observation o
          on o.engplanid = ep.eng_id
        LEFT join t_risk r
          on r.r_id = o.severity
        left join t_audit_para ap
          on ap.engplanid = ep.eng_id
       WHERE p.auditperiodid = 2
         and p.auditedby = Dept_id
       group by mp.entity_id, mp.name;
  
  end R_AuditPlanProgress;

  procedure R_useractivityreport(Dept_id in number, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select ET.NAME AS DEPT,
             G.DESCRIPTION AS ROLE,
             e.PPNO,
             e.EMPLOYEEFIRSTNAME || ' ' || e.EMPLOYEELASTNAME,
             count(distinct S.LOGGED_IN_DATE) as SESSIONS
        from T_USER U
       INNER JOIN T_USER_SESSION S
          ON U.PPNO = S.USER_PP_NUMBER
       INNER JOIN T_USER_MAPING UM
          ON UM.PPNO = U.PPNO
       INNER JOIN T_GROUPS G
          ON G.GROUP_ID = UM.GROUP_ID
       INNER JOIN V_SERVICE_EMPLOYEEINFO E
          ON E.PPNO = U.PPNO
       INNER JOIN T_AUDITEE_ENTITIES ET
          ON ET.ENTITY_ID = U.ENTITY_ID
       INNER JOIN T_AUDIT_DEPARTMENTS D
          ON D.ENTITY_ID = ET.ENTITY_ID
       WHERE trunc(s.logged_in_date) > '15-Jan-2023'
       group by ET.NAME,
                G.DESCRIPTION,
                e.PPNO,
                e.EMPLOYEEFIRSTNAME,
                e.EMPLOYEELASTNAME
      
      ;
  
  end R_useractivityreport;

  procedure R_Rolewisereport(Dept_id in number, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select ET.NAME AS DEPT,
             G.DESCRIPTION AS ROLE,
             count(DISTINCT u.ppno) AS USERS,
             count(distinct S.LOGGED_IN_DATE) as SESSIONS
        from T_USER U
       INNER JOIN T_USER_SESSION S
          ON U.PPNO = S.USER_PP_NUMBER
       INNER JOIN T_USER_MAPING UM
          ON UM.PPNO = U.PPNO
       INNER JOIN T_GROUPS G
          ON G.GROUP_ID = UM.GROUP_ID
       INNER JOIN V_SERVICE_EMPLOYEEINFO E
          ON E.PPNO = U.PPNO
       INNER JOIN T_AUDITEE_ENTITIES ET
          ON ET.ENTITY_ID = U.ENTITY_ID
       INNER JOIN T_AUDIT_DEPARTMENTS D
          ON D.ENTITY_ID = ET.ENTITY_ID
       WHERE ET.ENTITY_ID = Dept_id
       group by ET.NAME, G.DESCRIPTION
      
      ;
  
  end R_Rolewisereport;

  Procedure R_GetAuditees(PP_NO number, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
    V_F number := 0;
    E_F number := 0;
  begin
    Select m.role_id into V_F from t_user_maping m where m.ppno = PP_NO;
    select u.entity_id into E_F from t_user u where u.ppno = PP_NO;
    if (V_F = 18) then
      open io_cursor for
        select e.eng_id, ep.name as Entity_Name
          from t_au_audit_joining j
         inner join t_au_plan_eng e
            on e.eng_id = j.eng_plan_id
         inner join t_auditee_entities ep
            on ep.entity_id = e.entity_id
         where j.team_mem_ppno = PP_NO;
    else
      open io_cursor for
        select distinct (e.eng_id) as eng_id, ep.name as Entity_Name
          from t_au_audit_joining j
         inner join t_au_plan_eng e
            on e.eng_id = j.eng_plan_id
         inner join t_auditee_entities ep
            on ep.entity_id = e.entity_id
         where e.auditby_id = E_F;
    end if;
  
  end R_GetAuditees;

  Procedure R_GetAuditeesobervations(ENGID number, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    open io_cursor for
    
      select e.code,
             e.name as auditee,
             count(o.id) as observation,
             d.statusname as area
        from t_au_observation o
       inner join t_auditee_entities e
          on e.entity_id = o.entity_id
       inner join t_au_observation_status d
          on d.statusid = o.status
       inner join t_au_plan_eng ep
          on ep.eng_id = o.engplanid
       where ep.eng_id = ENGID
       group by e.code, e.name, d.statusname
       order by e.name;
  
  end R_GetAuditeesobervations;

  procedure R_LoginUsers(Entityid in number, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  
  begin
    if (Entityid in (112243, 113068)) then
      open io_cursor for
        select d.entity_id as entityid,
               d.deptname,
               s.user_pp_number as ppno,
               e.EMPLOYEEFIRSTNAME || ' ' || e.EMPLOYEELASTNAME as EmpName,
               s.logged_in_date as logindate,
               (Sysdate - s.logged_in_date) as Sessiontime
          from t_user_session s
         inner join t_audit_departments d
            on d.audit_id = s.posting_az
         inner join v_service_employeeinfo e
            on e.PPNO = s.user_pp_number
         where s.session_active = 'Y';
    else
      open io_cursor for
        select d.entity_id as entityid,
               d.deptname,
               s.user_pp_number as ppno,
               e.EMPLOYEEFIRSTNAME || ' ' || e.EMPLOYEELASTNAME as EmpName,
               s.logged_in_date as logindate,
               (Sysdate - s.logged_in_date) as Sessiontime
          from t_user_session s
         inner join t_audit_departments d
            on d.audit_id = s.posting_az
         inner join v_service_employeeinfo e
            on e.PPNO = s.user_pp_number
         where s.session_active = 'Y'
           and d.entity_id = Entityid;
    
    end if;
  
  end R_LoginUsers;

  procedure R_businessreview(io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select Sum(case
                   when t.disb_statusid = 11 then
                    t.disbursed_amount
                 end) as regular,
             Sum(case
                   when t.disb_statusid = 13 then
                    t.disbursed_amount
                 end) as oem,
             Sum(case
                   when t.disb_statusid = 14 then
                    t.disbursed_amount
                 end) as substandrad,
             Sum(case
                   when t.disb_statusid = 15 then
                    t.disbursed_amount
                 end) as soubtful,
             Sum(case
                   when t.disb_statusid = 16 then
                    t.disbursed_amount
                 end) as soss,
             Sum(case
                   when t.disb_statusid = 17 then
                    t.disbursed_amount
                 end) as sam
        from v_atas_t_loan_cnic_wise t;
  
  end R_businessreview;

  procedure R_GetDepartments(EntityId  in number,
                             ppnum     in number,
                             io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
    R_F number := 0;
    E_F number := 0;
  
  begin
    select nvl(max(u.entity_id), 0)
      into E_F
      from t_user u
     where u.ppno = ppnum;
    select NVL(max(m.role_id), 0)
      into R_F
      from t_User_Maping m
     where m.ppno = ppnum;
    if (R_F in (5, 15)) then
      open io_cursor for
        select mp.parent_id  as DIVISIONID,
               mp.entity_id  as ID,
               mp.c_name     as NAME,
               mp.child_code as CODE,
               e.active      as ISACTIVE,
               mp.p_name     as DIV_NAME,
               mp.auditedby  as AUDITED_BY_DEPID
          from t_auditee_entities e
         inner join t_auditee_entities_maping mp
            on mp.parent_id = e.entity_id
         where mp.entity_id is not null
           and e.entity_id = E_F
        union
        select 0 as DIVISIONID,
               0 as ID,
               'All' as NAME,
               0 as CODE,
               'Y' as ISACTIVE,
               'Y' as DIV_NAME,
               0 as AUDITED_BY_DEPID
          from dual;
    
    else
      open io_cursor for
        select mp.parent_id  as DIVISIONID,
               mp.entity_id  as ID,
               mp.c_name     as NAME,
               mp.child_code as CODE,
               mp.status     as ISACTIVE,
               mp.p_name     as DIV_NAME,
               mp.auditedby  as AUDITED_BY_DEPID
          from t_auditee_entities e, t_auditee_entities_maping mp
         where mp.entity_id is not null
           and e.type_id IN (3)
           and e.entity_id = mp.parent_id
           and e.entity_id = EntityId;
    end if;
  end R_GetDepartments;

  procedure R_getauditeeAddress(EngId     in number,
                                ppnum     in number,
                                io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select ep.eng_id,
             e.entity_id,
             NVL(mp.p_name, '-') as p_name,
             e.code,
             e.name,
             NVL(ed.address, ' --- ') as address,
             NVL(ed.date_of_opening, '01-Jan-9999') as date_of_opening,
             NVL(ed.license, ' Not Applicable ') as license,
             ep.audit_startdate,
             ep.audit_enddate,
             ep.operation_startdate,
             ep.operation_enddate,
             sum(case
                   when r.rating = 1 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as High,
             sum(case
                   when r.rating = 2 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Medium,
             sum(case
                   when r.rating = 3 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Low,
             sum(case
                   when r.rating = 1 and o.status in (9, 23) then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Settle_High,
             sum(case
                   when r.rating = 2 and o.status in (9, 23) then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as settle_Medium,
             sum(case
                   when r.rating = 3 and o.status in (9, 23) then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as settle_Low,
             sum(case
                   when r.rating = 1 and o.status = 8 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as open_High,
             sum(case
                   when r.rating = 2 and o.status = 8 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as open_Medium,
             sum(case
                   when r.rating = 3 and o.status = 8 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as open_Low
        from t_au_plan_eng ep
       inner join t_auditee_entities e
          on ep.entity_id = e.entity_id
       INNER join t_au_observation o
          on o.engplanid = ep.eng_id
       inner join t_risk r
          on r.rating = o.severity
        left join t_auditee_entities_address ed
          on ep.entity_id = ed.entity_id
        left join t_auditee_entities_maping mp
          on e.entity_id = mp.entity_id
       Where ep.eng_id = EngId
       group by ep.eng_id,
                e.entity_id,
                mp.p_name,
                e.code,
                e.name,
                ed.address,
                ed.date_of_opening,
                ed.license,
                ep.audit_startdate,
                ep.audit_enddate,
                ep.operation_startdate,
                ep.operation_enddate;
  
  end R_getauditeeAddress;

  procedure R_getauditeeParascount(EngId in number, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select count(ot.memo_number)
        from t_au_observation o
       inner join t_au_observation_text ot
          on o.id = ot.observatsion_id
       where o.engplanid = EngId
         and o.status = 8;
  end R_getauditeeParascount;

  procedure R_getauditeeParas(EngId in number, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
    V_F number := 0;
  begin
    select NVL(max(p.engplanid), 0)
      into V_F
      from t_audit_para p
     where p.engplanid = EngId;
    if (V_F != 0) then
      open io_cursor for
        select (case
                 when eg.eng_id = o.engplanid and o.entity_id = eg.entity_id then
                  'CAU'
                 else
                  'BRANCH'
               end) Assignedto,
               e.name as entity_name,
               pr.para_no,
               ot.memo_number,
               vd.description as V_Header,
               cd.heading as V_detail,
               rsk.description as Risk,
               ot.text as Observation,
               r.reply as Management_reply,
               ad.recommendation,
               'Please Review the audit report and in case of any discrepancy contact system administrator' as Message,
               '1' as REF_OUT
          from t_au_observation o
         inner join t_au_plan_eng eg
            on eg.eng_id = o.engplanid
         inner join t_au_observation_text ot
            on o.id = ot.observatsion_id
         inner join t_au_observations_auditee_response r
            on r.obs_text_id = ot.observatsion_id
         inner join t_au_observations_auditor_recommendation ad
            on ot.observatsion_id = ad.obs_text_id
         inner join t_au_observations_auditor_reply rs
            on rs.au_obs_id = o.id
           and rs.obs_text_id = ot.id
           and rs.obs_status = o.status
         inner join t_auditee_entities e
            on e.entity_id = o.entity_id
         inner join t_audit_para pr
            on pr.engplanid = o.engplanid
           and pr.memo_number = o.memo_number
           and pr.obid = o.id
         inner join t_audit_checklist_details cd
            on cd.id = o.checklistdetail_id
         inner join t_audit_checklist_sub csb
            on csb.s_id = cd.s_id
         inner join t_audit_checklist cl
            on cl.t_id = csb.t_id
         inner join t_risk rsk
            on rsk.r_id = cd.risk_id
         INNER JOIN T_audit_violation_detail vd
            ON vd.s_gr_id = cd.v_id
         where o.engplanid = EngId
           and o.status = 8
         order by pr.para_no;
    
    else
      open io_cursor for
        select 'Please Conculded/Close the Audit First' as Message,
               '0' as REF_OUT
          from dual;
    end if;
  
  end R_getauditeeParas;

  procedure R_getCAUParas(EngId in number, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select ot.memo_number,
             o.status,
             ot.text as text,
             r.reply,
             ad.recommendation,
             r.remarks,
             rs.reply_role as replyrole,
             rs.audit_reply as headremarks,
             (case
               when eg.eng_id = o.engplanid and o.entity_id = eg.entity_id then
                'CAU'
               else
                'BRANCH'
             end) Assignedto
        from t_au_observation o
       inner join t_au_plan_eng eg
          on eg.eng_id = o.engplanid
      
       inner join t_au_observation_text ot
          on o.id = ot.observatsion_id
       inner join t_au_observations_auditee_response r
          on r.obs_text_id = ot.observatsion_id
       inner join t_au_observations_auditor_recommendation ad
          on ot.observatsion_id = ad.obs_text_id
       inner join t_au_observations_auditor_reply rs
          on rs.au_obs_id = o.id
       where o.engplanid = EngId
         and o.status = 8
       order by o.memo_number;
  
  end R_getCAUParas;

  procedure R_getCAUbranchParas(EngId in number, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select ot.memo_number,
             o.status,
             ot.text           as text,
             r.reply,
             ad.recommendation,
             r.remarks,
             rs.reply_role     as replyrole,
             rs.audit_reply    as headremarks
        from t_au_observation o
       inner join t_au_plan_eng eg
          on eg.eng_id = o.engplanid
         and o.entity_id != eg.entity_id
       inner join t_au_observation_text ot
          on o.id = ot.observatsion_id
       inner join t_au_observations_auditee_response r
          on r.obs_text_id = ot.observatsion_id
       inner join t_au_observations_auditor_recommendation ad
          on ot.observatsion_id = ad.obs_text_id
       inner join t_au_observations_auditor_reply rs
          on rs.au_obs_id = o.id
       where o.engplanid = EngId
         and o.status = 8
       order by o.memo_number;
  
  end R_getCAUbranchParas;
