  procedure R_Eng_Plan(UserEntityID IN NUMBER,
                       EntityID     in number,
                       AZone        in number,
                       Risk_rating  in number,
                       Branch_Size  in number,
                       io_cursor    OUT t_cursor) as
  begin
    if (EntityID is null and AZone is null and Risk_rating is null and
       Branch_size is null) then
      open io_cursor for
        select dep.deptname          as Auditedby,
               etm.p_name            as ParrentOffice,
               et.name               as auditeename,
               et.code               as entitycode,
               et.entity_id          as antityid,
               etd.audit_enddate     as lastauditopsendate,
               rs.description        as entityrisk,
               etsd.description      as entitysize,
               p.no_of_days          as normaldays,
               ep.revenue_record_day as revenuedays,
               ep.travel_day         as travelday,
               ep.discussion_day     as discussionday,
               ep.audit_startdate    as auditstartdate,
               ep.audit_enddate      as auditenddate,
               ep.team_name          as tname,
               tm.member_name        as teamlead
          from t_au_plan_eng ep
         inner join t_auditee_entities et
            on et.entity_id = ep.entity_id
         inner join t_au_plan p
            on p.entity_id = ep.entity_id
           and p.auditperiodid = ep.period_id
           and p.id = ep.plan_id
         inner join t_auditee_entities_maping etm
            on etm.entity_id = ep.entity_id
         inner join t_auditee_ent_types ety
            on ety.autid = et.type_id
          left join t_audit_departments dep
            on dep.entity_id = ep.auditby_id
          left join t_auditee_entities_audit_dates etd
            on etd.entity_id = ep.entity_id
           and etd.audit_period_id = ep.period_id - 1
         inner join t_auditee_entities_size_disc etsd
            on etsd.entity_size = p.auditee_size
         inner join t_risk rs
            on rs.rating = p.auditee_risk
         inner join t_au_team_members tm
            on tm.t_id = ep.team_id
         where ep.period_id = 2
           and et.type_id in (6, 25)
           and ep.audit_startdate != '01-Jan-0001'
           and tm.isteamlead = 'Y'
           and ep.status in (4, 5)
           and etm.parent_id = UserEntityID
         order by ep.audit_startdate asc;
    else
      open io_cursor for
        select dep.deptname          as Auditedby,
               etm.p_name            as ParrentOffice,
               et.name               as auditeename,
               et.code               as entitycode,
               et.entity_id          as antityid,
               etd.audit_enddate     as lastauditopsendate,
               rs.description        as entityrisk,
               etsd.description      as entitysize,
               p.no_of_days          as normaldays,
               ep.revenue_record_day as revenuedays,
               ep.travel_day         as travelday,
               ep.discussion_day     as discussionday,
               ep.audit_startdate    as auditstartdate,
               ep.audit_enddate      as auditenddate,
               ep.team_name          as tname,
               tm.member_name        as teamlead
          from t_au_plan_eng ep
         inner join t_auditee_entities et
            on et.entity_id = ep.entity_id
         inner join t_au_plan p
            on p.entity_id = ep.entity_id
           and p.auditperiodid = ep.period_id
           and p.id = ep.plan_id
         inner join t_auditee_entities_maping etm
            on etm.entity_id = ep.entity_id
         inner join t_auditee_ent_types ety
            on ety.autid = et.type_id
          left join t_audit_departments dep
            on dep.entity_id = ep.auditby_id
          left join t_auditee_entities_audit_dates etd
            on etd.entity_id = ep.entity_id
           and etd.audit_period_id = ep.period_id - 1
         inner join t_auditee_entities_size_disc etsd
            on etsd.entity_size = p.auditee_size
        
         inner join t_risk rs
            on rs.rating = p.auditee_risk
         inner join t_au_team_members tm
            on tm.t_id = ep.team_id
         where ep.period_id = 2
           and et.type_id in (6, 25)
           and ep.audit_startdate != '01-Jan-0001'
           and tm.isteamlead = 'Y'
           and ep.status in (4, 5)
           and etm.parent_id = UserEntityID
           and ep.entity_id = EntityID
           and etsd.entity_size = Branch_Size
           and ep.auditby_id = AZone
           and p.auditee_risk = Risk_rating
         order by ep.audit_startdate asc;
    end if;
  
  end R_Eng_Plan;

  procedure P_GetParaPositionForZoneBranches(userid    in number,
                                             EntityId  in number,
                                             io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
    ent_type_id number := 0;
  begin
    select e.type_id
      into ent_type_id
      from t_auditee_entities e
     where e.entity_id = EntityId;
    if (userid in (112243, 112248, 113068)) then
      if ent_type_id = 6 then
        open io_cursor for
          select e.name as branch_name,
                 count(o.id) as Total_Paras,
                 sum(case
                       when o.para_status = '6' then
                        1
                       else
                        0
                     end) as Setteled_para,
                 sum(case
                       when o.para_status = '8' then
                        1
                       else
                        0
                     end) as UnSetteled_para
            from t_au_observation_fad o
           inner join t_auditee_entities e
              on e.entity_id = o.entity_id
           where o.entity_id = EntityId
           group by e.name;
      else
        open io_cursor for
          Select tm.c_name as branch_name,
                 Count(o.id) as Total_Paras,
                 sum(case
                       when o.para_status = '6' then
                        1
                       else
                        0
                     end) as Setteled_para,
                 sum(case
                       when o.para_status = '8' then
                        1
                       else
                        0
                     end) as UnSetteled_para
            from t_au_observation_fad o
           inner join t_auditee_entities_maping tm
              on tm.entity_id = o.entity_id
             and tm.parent_id = EntityId
           group by tm.c_name;
      
      end if;
    
    else
      if ent_type_id = 6 then
        open io_cursor for
          select e.name as branch_name,
                 count(*) as Total_Paras,
                 sum(case
                       when o.para_status = '6' then
                        1
                       else
                        0
                     end) as Setteled_para,
                 sum(case
                       when o.para_status = '8' then
                        1
                       else
                        0
                     end) as UnSetteled_para
            from t_au_observation_fad o
           inner join t_auditee_entities e
              on e.entity_id = o.entity_id
           where o.entity_id = EntityId
             and o.audited_by = userid
           group by e.name;
      else
        open io_cursor for
          Select tm.c_name as branch_name,
                 Count(*) as Total_Paras,
                 sum(case
                       when o.para_status = '6' then
                        1
                       else
                        0
                     end) as Setteled_para,
                 sum(case
                       when o.para_status = '8' then
                        1
                       else
                        0
                     end) as UnSetteled_para
            from t_au_observation_fad o
           inner join t_auditee_entities_maping tm
              on tm.entity_id = o.entity_id
             and tm.parent_id = EntityId
           where o.audited_by = userid
           group by tm.c_name;
      end if;
    
    end if;
  
  end P_GetParaPositionForZoneBranches;

  procedure P_Get_lagacy_Paras_Performance(UserEntityID IN NUMBER,
                                           io_cursor    OUT t_cursor) as
  begin
    OPEN io_cursor FOR
      select ck.heading as Audit_Zone,
             count(o.old_para_id) as Total_Paras,
             sum(case
                   when o.para_status = '6' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Setteled_para,
             sum(case
                   when o.para_status = '8' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as UnSetteled_para,
             cast((sum(case
                         when o.para_status = '6' then
                          1
                         else
                          0
                       end) / count(o.old_para_id) * 100) as decimal(10, 2)) || ' %' as Ratio,
             sum(case
                   when cd.risk_id = '1' and o.para_status = '8' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as R1,
             sum(case
                   when cd.risk_id = '2' and o.para_status = '8' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as R2,
             sum(case
                   when cd.risk_id = '3' and o.para_status = '8' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as R3
        from t_au_observation_fad o
       inner join t_au_old_paras_fad fd
          on fd.id = o.old_para_id
       inner join t_audit_checklist_details cd
          on cd.id = fd.process_detail
       inner join t_audit_checklist_sub sb
          on cd.s_id = sb.s_id
       inner join t_audit_checklist ck
          on ck.t_id = sb.t_id
       inner join t_auditee_entities e
          on e.entity_id = o.audited_by
       where o.old_para_id is not null
       group by ck.heading
       order by ck.heading;
  end P_Get_lagacy_Paras_Performance;

  procedure P_Get_New_Paras_Performance(UserEntityID IN NUMBER,
                                        io_cursor    OUT t_cursor) as
  begin
    OPEN io_cursor FOR
      select e.name as Audit_Zone,
             count(o.id) as Total_Paras,
             sum(case
                   when o.status = '9' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Setteled_para,
             sum(case
                   when o.status = '8' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as UnSetteled_para,
             cast((sum(case
                         when o.status = '9' then
                          1
                         else
                          0
                       end) / count(o.id) * 100) as decimal(10, 2)) || ' %' as Ratio,
             sum(case
                   when cd.risk_id = '1' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as R1,
             sum(case
                   when cd.risk_id = '2' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as R2,
             sum(case
                   when cd.risk_id = '3' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as R3
      
        from t_au_observation o
       inner join t_au_plan_eng eg
          on eg.eng_id = o.engplanid
       inner join t_auditee_entities e
          on e.entity_id = eg.auditby_id
         and e.entity_id <> '112248'
       inner join t_audit_checklist_details cd
          on cd.id = o.checklistdetail_id
       where o.status not in (23, 27)
         and eg.period_id = 2
       group by e.name;
  end P_Get_New_Paras_Performance;

  procedure P_GET_NEW_OLD_PARAS_PERFORMANCE(UserEntityID IN NUMBER,
                                            io_cursor    OUT t_cursor) as
  begin
    OPEN io_cursor FOR
      select DISTINCT E.NAME AS AUDIT_ZONE,
                      ck.heading as Checklist,
                      count(o.old_para_id) as Total_Paras,
                      sum(case
                            when o.para_status = '9' then
                             1
                            else
                             0
                          end) as Setteled_para,
                      sum(case
                            when o.para_status = '8' then
                             1
                            else
                             0
                          end) as UnSetteled_para,
                      cast((sum(case
                                  when o.para_status = '9' then
                                   1
                                  else
                                   0
                                end) / count(O.new_paraid) * 100) as
                           decimal(10, 2)) || ' %' as Ratio,
                      sum(case
                            when cd.risk_id = '1' and o.para_status = '8' then
                             1
                            else
                             0
                          end) as R1,
                      sum(case
                            when cd.risk_id = '2' and o.para_status = '8' then
                             1
                            else
                             0
                          end) as R2,
                      sum(case
                            when cd.risk_id = '3' and o.para_status = '8' then
                             1
                            else
                             0
                          end) as R3
        from t_au_observation_fad o
       inner join t_Au_Observation fd
          on fd.id = o.new_paraid
       INNER JOIN T_AU_PLAN_ENG EN
          ON EN.ENG_ID = FD.ENGPLANID
       inner join t_audit_checklist_details cd
          on cd.id = FD.CHECKLISTDETAIL_ID
       inner join t_audit_checklist_sub sb
          on cd.s_id = sb.s_id
       inner join t_audit_checklist ck
          on ck.t_id = sb.t_id
       inner join t_auditee_entities e
          on e.entity_id = EN.AUDITBY_ID
       where FD.ENTEREDDATE > '01-JAN-2024'
      
       group by E.NAME, ck.heading
       order by E.NAME, ck.heading;
  end P_GET_NEW_OLD_PARAS_PERFORMANCE;

  procedure P_Get_UserWise_OldParasPerformance(UserEntityID IN NUMBER,
                                               updated_date in date,
                                               io_cursor    OUT t_cursor) as
  begin
    if (UserEntityID = '112248') then
      OPEN io_cursor FOR
        select s.*, sz.zonename
          from v_report_az_emp_progress_datacleansing s
         inner join v_report_az_progress sz
            on s.audit_zoneid = sz.id;
    
    else
      if (updated_date is null) then
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          select s.*, sz.zonename
            from v_report_az_emp_progress_datacleansing s
           inner join v_report_az_progress sz
              on s.audit_zoneid = sz.id
           WHERE s.AUDIT_ZONEID = UserEntityID;
      else
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          select s.*, sz.zonename
            from v_report_az_emp_progress_datacleansing s
           inner join v_report_az_progress sz
              on s.audit_zoneid = sz.id
           WHERE s.AUDIT_ZONEID = UserEntityID
             and s.Updated_ON = updated_date;
      end if;
    end if;
  end P_Get_UserWise_OldParasPerformance;

  procedure P_Get_FAD_UserWise_OldParasPerformance(PP_NO        IN NUMBER,
                                                   updated_date in date,
                                                   io_cursor    OUT t_cursor) as
  begin
    if (updated_date is null) then
      OPEN io_cursor FOR
        select t.desk_officer as ppno,
               e.EMPLOYEEFIRSTNAME || '  ' || e.EMPLOYEELASTNAME as emp_name,
               Sum(case
                     when t.para_reviewed = 1 then
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   end) as Para_reviewed,
               sum(case
                     when t.para_final = 1 then
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   end) as Para_Updated,
               sum(case
                     when t.para_final_no_update = 1 then
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   end) as PARA_UPDATED_WITHOUT_CHANGES,
               sum(case
                     when t.para_refered_back = 1 then
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   end) as Refer_Back
          from T_AU_DATA_VALIDATION_FAD_LOG t
         inner join v_service_employeeinfo e
            on e.PPNO = t.desk_officer
         group by t.desk_officer,
                  e.EMPLOYEEFIRSTNAME || '  ' || e.EMPLOYEELASTNAME;
    else
      OPEN io_cursor FOR
        select t.desk_officer as ppno,
               e.EMPLOYEEFIRSTNAME || '  ' || e.EMPLOYEELASTNAME as emp_name,
               Sum(case
                     when t.para_reviewed = 1 then
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   end) as Para_reviewed,
               sum(case
                     when t.para_final = 1 then
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   end) as Para_Updated,
               sum(case
                     when t.para_final_no_update = 1 then
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   end) as PARA_UPDATED_WITHOUT_CHANGES,
               sum(case
                     when t.para_refered_back = 1 then
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   end) as Refer_Back
          from T_AU_DATA_VALIDATION_FAD_LOG t
         inner join v_service_employeeinfo e
            on e.PPNO = t.desk_officer
         WHERE trunc(t.fad_date) = updated_date
         group by t.desk_officer,
                  e.EMPLOYEEFIRSTNAME || '  ' || e.EMPLOYEELASTNAME;
    end if;
  
  end P_Get_FAD_UserWise_OldParasPerformance;

  procedure p_get_para_position(UserEntityID IN NUMBER,
                                P_ID         in number,
                                C_ID         in number,
                                io_cursor    OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    if (P_ID = 0 and C_ID = 0) then
      open io_cursor for
        select '' as p_name,
               '' as c_name,
               v.AUDIT_PERIOD,
               sum(v.Total_para) as Total_para,
               sum(v.Setteled_para) as setteled_para,
               sum(v.Un_Setteled_para) as Un_Setteled_para
          from v_report_para_position v
         where v.entity_id = UserEntityID
         group by v.AUDIT_PERIOD
         order by v.AUDIT_PERIOD;
    
    else
      if (P_ID != 0 and C_ID = 0) then
        open io_cursor for
          select v.p_name,
                 '' as c_name,
                 v.AUDIT_PERIOD,
                 sum(v.Total_para) as Total_para,
                 sum(v.Setteled_para) as setteled_para,
                 sum(v.Un_Setteled_para) as Un_Setteled_para
            from v_report_para_position v
           where v.entity_id = UserEntityID
             and v.parent_id = P_ID
           group by v.p_name, v.AUDIT_PERIOD
           order by v.p_name, v.AUDIT_PERIOD;
      else
        if (P_ID != 0 and C_ID != 0) then
          open io_cursor for
            select v.p_name,
                   v.c_name,
                   v.AUDIT_PERIOD,
                   v.Total_para,
                   v.Setteled_para,
                   v.Un_Setteled_para
              from v_report_para_position v
             where v.entity_id = UserEntityID
               and v.parent_id = P_ID
               and v.c_entity_id = C_ID;
        end if;
      end if;
    end if;
  
  end p_get_para_position;

  procedure p_get_para_position_details(UserEntityID IN NUMBER,
                                        period       in number,
                                        io_cursor    OUT t_cursor) is
    V_F number := 0;
  begin
  
    if (UserEntityID = 0) then
      open io_cursor for
        select '' as audit_period,
               '' as para_no,
               '' as para_status,
               'Option works for Audit Period wise Para details of Branches, so Please first select Zone and Branch, press Search Button and then click on this option ' as remarks
          from dual;
    
    else
      select NVL(e.type_id, 0)
        into V_F
        from t_auditee_entities e
       where e.entity_id = UserEntityID;
      if (V_F in (6, 25)) then
        open io_cursor for
          select v.AUDIT_PERIOD,
                 v.para_no,
                 v.gist_of_paras,
                 (case
                   when v.para_status = 8 then
                    'Unsetteled'
                   else
                    'Setteled'
                 end) as para_status,
                 '' as remarks
          
            from v_report_dashborad_detail v
           where v.ENTITY_ID = UserEntityID
             and v.audit_period = period;
      else
        open io_cursor for
        
          select '' as audit_period,
                 '' as para_no,
                 '' as para_status,
                 'Option works for Audit Period wise Para details of Branches, so Please first select Zone and Branch, press Search Button and then click on this option ' as remarks
            from dual;
      end if;
    end if;
  end p_get_para_position_details;

  procedure P_GET_Dash_table_functionwise_HO(UserEntityID IN NUMBER,
                                             ENT_ID       in number,
                                             P_NO         in number,
                                             R_ID         in number,
                                             io_cursor    OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
  
    OPEN io_cursor FOR
      select upper(e.name) as Functional_owner,
             count(o.entity_id) as Total_Paras,
             sum(case
                   when o.para_status = '9' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Setteled_para,
             sum(case
                   when o.para_status = '8' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as UnSetteled_para,
             cast((sum(case
                         when o.para_status = '9' then
                          1
                         else
                          0
                       end) / count(o.ID) * 100) as decimal(10, 2)) || ' %' as Ratio,
             sum(case
                   when sb.risk_id = '1' and o.para_status = '8' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as R1,
             sum(case
                   when sb.risk_id = '2' and o.para_status = '8' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as R2,
             sum(case
                   when sb.risk_id = '3' and o.para_status = '8' then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as R3
      
        from v_get_dash_table_functionwise_names_ho o
       inner join t_coso_rating_factors cd
          on cd.id = o.v_cat_id
       inner join t_control_violation_sub sb
          on o.V_CAT_NATURE_ID = sb.id
       inner join t_risk ck
          on ck.r_id = sb.risk_id
       inner join t_auditee_entities e
          on e.entity_id = o.entity_id
       where e.auditby_id = UserEntityID
       group by e.name;
  
  end P_GET_Dash_table_functionwise_HO;

  Procedure P_GET_ACTIVITY_LOG(P_NO      in number,
                               Role      in number,
                               A_date    in date,
                               io_cursor out t_cursor) as
  
  begin
  
    open io_cursor for
      select l.id,
             l.entity_id,
             (Select d.group_name
                from t_groups d
               where d.role_id = l.role_id) as Group_Role,
             l.ppnum,
             (Select e.employeefirstname || ' ' || e.employeelastname
                from v_service_employeeinfo e
               where e.ppno = l.ppnum) as E_NAME,
             (select m.page_name from t_menu_pages m where m.id = l.page_id) as page_id,
             l.au_obs_id,
             l.action,
             l.start_time,
             l.end_time,
             round((l.end_time - l.start_time) * 1440) as duration,
             l.seq,
             l.unattend
        from t_au_activity_log l
      
       where l.ppnum = p_no
         AND trunc(l.start_time) >= trunc(sysdate) - 10
         AND trunc(l.start_time) <= trunc(sysdate)
       order by l.start_time desc;
  
  end P_GET_ACTIVITY_LOG;

  procedure P_GET_SETTLED_PARA_ENTITIES(P_NO      in number,
                                        ENT_ID    in number,
                                        R_ID      in number,
                                        io_cursor out t_cursor) as
  begin
    If (R_ID in (1)) then
      open io_cursor for
        select distinct e.name, e.entity_id
          from V_P_GET_SETTLED_PARA_DETAILS f
         inner join t_auditee_entities e
            on e.entity_id = f.entity_id
         inner join T_AU_POST_COMPLIANCE_SETTLEMETMENT_HISTORY h
            on h.entity_id = f.entity_id
         where h.reviewed_by is null;
    else
      open io_cursor for
        select distinct e.name, e.entity_id
          from V_P_GET_SETTLED_PARA_DETAILS f
         inner join t_auditee_entities e
            on e.entity_id = f.entity_id
         inner join t_auditee_entities_maping fad
            on fad.entity_id = e.entity_id
         inner join T_AU_POST_COMPLIANCE_SETTLEMETMENT_HISTORY h
            on h.entity_id = f.entity_id
         where fad.parent_id = ent_id;
    end if;
  end P_GET_SETTLED_PARA_ENTITIES;

  Procedure P_GET_SETTLED_PARA_DETAILS(P_NO       in number,
                                       ENT_ID     in number,
                                       R_ID       in number,
                                       auditee_id in number,
                                       io_cursor  OUT t_cursor) is
  
  begin
  
    OPEN io_cursor for
      select d.reporting_office,
             d.Entity_name,
             d.audit_period,
             d.para_no,
             d.settled_by,
             d.settled_on,
             d.risk,
             d.para_category,
             d.ref_p,
             d.au_obs_id,
             d.compliance_cycle,
             d.entity_id,
             d.auditedby
        from V_P_GET_SETTLED_PARA_DETAILS d
       where d.entity_id = auditee_id;
  
  end P_GET_SETTLED_PARA_DETAILS;

  Procedure P_GET_SETTLED_PARA_DETAILS_PARA_COMPLIANCE(refp      varchar2,
                                                       obs_id    in number,
                                                       io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    OPEN io_cursor for
      select c.attended_by,
             d.description as designation,
             emp.employeefirstname || '  ' || emp.employeelastname as emp_name,
             c.remarks
      
        from T_AU_POST_COMPLIANCE_SETTLEMETMENT_HISTORY h
       inner join t_auditee_entities_maping_fad f
          on f.entity_id = h.auditedby
       inner join T_AU_OLD_PARAS_POST_COMPLIANCE_HISTORY c
          on (c.ref_p = h.ref_p or c.au_obs_id = h.au_obs_id)
         and c.com_seq_id = h.compliance_cycle
       inner join v_service_employeeinfo emp
          on emp.ppno = c.attended_by
       inner join t_hr_designations d
          on d.designationcode = c.roleid
       where (h.ref_p = refp or h.au_obs_id = obs_id)
       order by c.seq;
  
  end P_GET_SETTLED_PARA_DETAILS_PARA_COMPLIANCE;

  Procedure P_GET_COMPLIANCE_SUM(io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select sum(t.Total_Comp) as Complaince_Submitted,
             sum(t.Referredback_by_RPT) as Referredback_by_Controlling_office,
             sum(t.at_IMP) as Complaince_received_at_Incharge_implementation,
             sum(t.Referred_back_by_IMP) as Complaince_Referred_back_by_Incharge_Implementation,
             sum(t.AT_To_Incharge_AZ) as Complaince_Submitted_To_Incharge_AZ,
             sum(t.Referred_back_by_Incharge_AZ) as Complaince_Referred_back_by_Incharge_AZ,
             sum(t.Para_settled_by_Incharge_AZ) as settled
      
        from V_RPT_COMPLAINCE_STATUS_WISE t;
  
  end P_GET_COMPLIANCE_SUM;

  Procedure P_GET_COMPLIANCE_STATUS_WISE(P_NO       in number,
                                         ENT_ID     in number,
                                         R_ID       in number,
                                         R_C        in varchar2,
                                         auditee_id in number,
                                         S_Date     in date,
                                         E_Date     in date,
                                         io_cursor  OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select r.parent_id,
             r.Parent_Office,
             r.entity_id,
             r.entity_name,
             r.auditby_id,
             sum(t.Total_Comp) as Complaince_Submitted,
             sum(t.Referredback_by_RPT) as Referredback_by_Controlling_office,
             sum(t.at_IMP) as Complaince_received_at_Incharge_implementation,
             sum(t.Referred_back_by_IMP) as Complaince_Referred_back_by_Incharge_Implementation,
             sum(t.AT_To_Incharge_AZ) as Complaince_Submitted_To_Incharge_AZ,
             sum(t.Referred_back_by_Incharge_AZ) as Complaince_Referred_back_by_Incharge_AZ,
             sum(t.Para_settled_by_Incharge_AZ) as para_settled_by_Incharge_AZ
        from V_RPT_COMPLAINCE_STATUS_WISE t
       inner join v_relationship_office r
          on r.entity_id = t.entity_id
       where auditee_id = (case
               when R_C = 'P' then
                r.parent_id
               else
                (case
                  when R_C = 'C' then
                   r.entity_id
                  else
                   auditee_id
                end)
             end)
      
       group by r.parent_id,
                r.Parent_Office,
                r.entity_id,
                r.entity_name,
                r.auditby_id;
  end P_GET_COMPLIANCE_STATUS_WISE;

  Procedure P_GET_COMPLIANCE_DETAILS(P_NO       in number,
                                     ENT_ID     in number,
                                     R_ID       in number,
                                     auditee_id in number,
                                     C_Date     in date,
                                     io_cursor  OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
  
    open io_cursor for
    
      Select h.attended_on,
             h.attended_by,
             (select d.description
                from t_hr_designations d
               where d.designationcode = h.roleid) as Designation,
             h.remarks
        from t_au_old_paras_post_compliance_history h
       inner join v_relationship_office e
          on e.entity_id = h.entity_id
      
       where e.entity_id = auditee_id;
  end P_GET_COMPLIANCE_DETAILS;

  procedure P_FAD_audit_Para_Reconciliation(P_NO      in number,
                                            ENT_ID    in number,
                                            R_ID      in number,
                                            io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
    T_F number := 0;
  begin
    select e.type_id
      into T_F
      from t_auditee_entities e
     where e.entity_id = ent_id;
    if (T_F = 9) then
      open io_cursor for
        select r.name as Audit_zone,
               r.entitytypedesc,
               r.Reporting_Office,
               r.Auditee,
               r.Open_balance,
               r.Added,
               r.Total,
               r.Settled_Legacy,
               r.Settled_New_Paras,
               r.Un_Settled,
               round(((r.Settled_Legacy + r.Settled_New_Paras) / r.Total) * 100) as percentage,
               'Z' as ind,
               sum(r.R1) as R1,
               sum(r.R2) as R2,
               sum(r.R3) as R3
          from v_FAD_audit_Para_Reconciliation r
         where r.az_id = ENT_ID
           and r.Total > 0
         group by r.name,
                  r.entitytypedesc,
                  r.Reporting_Office,
                  r.Auditee,
                  r.Open_balance,
                  r.Added,
                  r.Total,
                  r.Settled_Legacy,
                  r.Settled_New_Paras,
                  r.Un_Settled
         order by r.parent_id;
    else
      if (r_id in (1, 3)) then
        open io_cursor for
          select r.name as Audit_zone,
                 r.auditby_id,
                 '' as entitytypedesc,
                 '' as Reporting_Office,
                 '' as Auditee,
                 sum(r.Open_balance) as Open_balance,
                 sum(r.Added) as added,
                 sum(r.Total) as total,
                 sum(r.Settled_Legacy) as Settled_Legacy,
                 sum(r.Settled_New_Paras) as Settled_New_Paras,
                 sum(r.Un_Settled) as Un_Settled,
                 round((sum(r.Settled_New_Paras) + sum(r.Settled_Legacy)) /
                       (sum(r.Total)) * 100) as percentage,
                 'A' as ind,
                 sum(r.R1) as r1,
                 sum(r.R2) as r2,
                 sum(r.R3) as r3
            from v_FAD_audit_Para_Reconciliation r
           where r.Total > 0
             and r.name is not null
           group by r.name, r.auditby_id
           order by r.auditby_id;
      
      else
        if (r_id in (6, 7, 9, 11)) then
          open io_cursor for
            select r.name as Audit_zone,
                   r.auditby_id,
                   r.entitytypedesc,
                   r.Reporting_Office,
                   r.Auditee,
                   r.Open_balance,
                   r.Added,
                   r.Total,
                   r.Settled_Legacy,
                   r.Settled_New_Paras,
                   r.Un_Settled,
                   round(((r.Settled_Legacy + r.Settled_New_Paras) /
                         r.Total) * 100) as percentage,
                   'Z' as ind,
                   sum(r.R1) as R1,
                   sum(r.R2) as R2,
                   sum(r.R3) as R3
              from v_FAD_audit_Para_Reconciliation r
             where r.auditby_id = ENT_ID
               and r.Total > 0
             group by r.name,
                      r.entitytypedesc,
                      r.Reporting_Office,
                      r.Auditee,
                      r.Open_balance,
                      r.Added,
                      r.Total,
                      r.Settled_Legacy,
                      r.Settled_New_Paras,
                      r.Un_Settled
             order by r.az_id, r.parent_id;
        else
          if (r_id in (5, 11)) then
            open io_cursor for
            /* select r.name as Audit_zone,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 r.entitytypedesc,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 r.Reporting_Office,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 r.Auditee,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 r.Open_balance,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 r.Added,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 r.Total,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 r.Settled_Legacy,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 r.Settled_New_Paras,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 r.Un_Settled,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 round(((r.Settled_Legacy + r.Settled_New_Paras) /
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       r.Total) * 100) as percentage,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 'Z' as ind,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               sum(r.R1) as R1,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               sum(r.R2) as R2,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               sum(r.R3) as R3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            from v_FAD_audit_Para_Reconciliation r
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           where r.auditby_id not in (112248, 112242)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             and r.Total > 0
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           order by r.az_id, r.parent_id; */
            
              select r.name as Audit_zone,
                     r.az_id,
                     r.parent_id,
                     r.entitytypedesc,
                     r.Reporting_Office,
                     r.Auditee,
                     r.Open_balance,
                     r.Added,
                     r.Total,
                     r.Settled_Legacy,
                     r.Settled_New_Paras,
                     r.Un_Settled,
                     round(((r.Settled_Legacy + r.Settled_New_Paras) /
                           r.Total) * 100) as percentage,
                     'Z' as ind,
                     sum(r.R1) as R1,
                     sum(r.R2) as R2,
                     sum(r.R3) as R3
                from v_FAD_audit_Para_Reconciliation r
               where r.auditby_id not in (112248, 112242)
                 and r.Total > 0
               group by r.name,
                        r.entitytypedesc,
                        r.az_id,
                        r.parent_id,
                        r.Reporting_Office,
                        r.Auditee,
                        r.Open_balance,
                        r.Added,
                        r.Total,
                        r.Settled_Legacy,
                        r.Settled_New_Paras,
                        r.Un_Settled
               order by r.az_id, r.parent_id;
          else
            if (ENT_ID = 112243) then
              open io_cursor for
                select r.name as Audit_zone,
                       r.entitytypedesc,
                       r.Reporting_Office,
                       r.Auditee,
                       r.Open_balance,
                       r.Added,
                       r.Total,
                       r.Settled_Legacy,
                       r.Settled_New_Paras,
                       r.Un_Settled,
                       round(((r.Settled_Legacy + r.Settled_New_Paras) /
                             r.Total) * 100) as percentage,
                       'F' as ind,
                       sum(r.R1) as R1,
                       sum(r.R2) as R2,
                       sum(r.R3) as R3
                  from v_FAD_audit_Para_Reconciliation r
                 inner join t_auditee_entities_maping_fad f
                    on f.entity_id = r.az_id
                   and r.auditby_id not in (112248, 112242)
                 where f.ppno = P_NO
                   and r.Total > 0
                 group by r.name,
                          r.entitytypedesc,
                          r.Reporting_Office,
                          r.Auditee,
                          r.Open_balance,
                          r.Added,
                          r.Total,
                          r.Settled_Legacy,
                          r.Settled_New_Paras,
                          r.Un_Settled
                 order by r.name, r.entitytypedesc, r.parent_id;
            else
              if (R_ID = 14) then
                open io_cursor for
                  select r.name as Audit_zone,
                         r.entitytypedesc,
                         r.Reporting_Office,
                         r.Auditee,
                         r.Open_balance,
                         r.Added,
                         r.Total,
                         r.Settled_Legacy,
                         r.Settled_New_Paras,
                         r.Un_Settled,
                         round(((r.Settled_Legacy + r.Settled_New_Paras) /
                               r.Total) * 100) as percentage,
                         'F' as ind,
                         sum(r.R1) as R1,
                         sum(r.R2) as R2,
                         sum(r.R3) as R3
                    from v_man_audit_para_reconciliation r
                   where r.parent_id = ENT_ID
                     and r.Total > 0
                   group by r.name,
                            r.entitytypedesc,
                            r.Reporting_Office,
                            r.Auditee,
                            r.Open_balance,
                            r.Added,
                            r.Total,
                            r.Settled_Legacy,
                            r.Settled_New_Paras,
                            r.Un_Settled
                   order by r.name, r.entitytypedesc, r.parent_id;
              
              end if;
            end if;
          end if;
        end if;
      end if;
    end if;
  end P_FAD_audit_Para_Reconciliation;

  procedure P_audit_Para_position(E_ID      in number,
                                  E_DATE    in date,
                                  io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
  
    open io_cursor for
      select t.az_id,
             t.parent_id,
             t.entity_id,
             t.auditby_id,
             t.name,
             t.entitytypedesc,
             t.Reporting_Office,
             t.Auditee,
             sum(case
                   when f.entereddate < E_DATE and f.para_status in (8) and
                        f.stelled_on is null then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Opening,
             sum(case
                   when f.entereddate > E_DATE then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Added,
             sum(case
                   when f.entereddate > E_DATE and f.para_status in (9, 23) then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Settled,
             sum(case
                   when f.para_status = 8 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Outstanding
        from V_FAD_AUDIT_PARA_RECONCILIATION_ENTITIES t
       inner join t_au_observation_fad f
          on t.entity_id = f.entity_id
      
       where t.type_id = E_ID
      
       group by t.az_id,
                t.parent_id,
                t.entity_id,
                t.auditby_id,
                t.name,
                t.entitytypedesc,
                t.Reporting_Office,
                t.Auditee;
  
  end P_audit_Para_position;

  procedure P_FAD_audit_Plan_Details(AUDIT_ID  in number,
                                     P_ID      in number,
                                     io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
    if (AUDIT_ID != 0 and AUDIT_ID != 112243) then
      open io_cursor for
        select distinct e.eng_id,
                        m.p_name as reporting_office,
                        ee.name,
                        t.t_name,
                        e.operation_startdate,
                        e.operation_enddate,
                        e.audit_startdate,
                        e.audit_enddate,
                        e.travel_day,
                        e.discussion_day,
                        e.revenue_record_day,
                        (SELECT COUNT(*)
                           FROM (SELECT e.audit_startdate + LEVEL - 1 AS dt
                                   FROM dual
                                 CONNECT BY LEVEL <= e.audit_enddate -
                                            e.audit_startdate + 1)
                          WHERE TO_CHAR(dt, 'DY') IN ('SAT', 'SUN')) AS total_weekend_days,
                        (e.audit_enddate - e.audit_startdate) +
                        nvl(e.travel_day, 0) + nvl(e.discussion_day, 0) +
                        nvl(e.revenue_record_day, 0) AS total_days,
                        (case
                          when e.status < 14 and
                               trunc(e.audit_enddate) < trunc(sysdate) then
                           (trunc(sysdate) - (trunc(e.audit_enddate) + 15))
                          else
                           0
                        end) as delay_days,
                        es.status
          from t_au_plan_eng e
         inner join t_au_plan p
            on p.id = e.plan_id
         inner join t_auditee_entities ee
            on e.entity_id = ee.entity_id
         inner join t_auditee_entities_maping m
            on ee.entity_id = m.entity_id
         inner join t_au_plan_eng_status es
            on es.id = e.status
         inner join t_au_audit_teams t
            on e.eng_id = t.eng_id
         where p.auditperiodid = P_ID
           and ee.auditby_id = AUDIT_ID
         order by e.audit_startdate;
    else
      open io_cursor for
        select e.eng_id,
               m.p_name as reporting_office,
               ee.name,
               t.t_name,
               e.operation_startdate,
               e.operation_enddate,
               e.audit_startdate,
               e.audit_enddate,
               e.travel_day,
               e.discussion_day,
               e.revenue_record_day,
               (SELECT COUNT(*)
                  FROM (SELECT e.audit_startdate + LEVEL - 1 AS dt
                          FROM dual
                        CONNECT BY LEVEL <=
                                   e.audit_enddate - e.audit_startdate + 1)
                 WHERE TO_CHAR(dt, 'DY') IN ('SAT', 'SUN')) AS total_weekend_days,
               (e.audit_enddate - e.audit_startdate) + nvl(e.travel_day, 0) +
               nvl(e.discussion_day, 0) + nvl(e.revenue_record_day, 0) AS total_days,
               (case
                 when e.status < 14 and
                      trunc(e.audit_enddate) < trunc(sysdate) then
                  (trunc(sysdate) - (trunc(e.audit_enddate) + 15))
                 else
                  0
               end) as delay_days,
               es.status
          from t_au_plan_eng e
        
         inner join t_auditee_entities az
            on az.entity_id = e.auditby_id
         inner join t_auditee_entities ee
            on e.entity_id = ee.entity_id
         inner join t_auditee_entities_maping m
            on ee.entity_id = m.entity_id
         inner join t_au_plan_eng_status es
            on es.id = e.status
         inner join t_au_audit_teams t
            on e.eng_id = t.eng_id
          Left join t_au_plan p
            on p.id = e.plan_id
         where e.period_id = P_ID
           and az.type_id = 9
        
        union all
        select null as eng_id,
               m.p_name as reporting_office,
               ee.name,
               'Yet to be aggined' as t_name,
               null as operation_startdate,
               null as operation_enddate,
               null as audit_startdate,
               null as audit_enddate,
               0 as travel_day,
               0 as discussion_day,
               0 as revenue_record_day,
               0 AS total_weekend_days,
               0 as delay_days,
               0 as total_days,
               es.status
          from t_au_plan ep
         inner join t_auditee_entities az
            on az.entity_id = ep.auditedby
         inner join t_auditee_entities ee
            on ep.entity_id = ee.entity_id
         inner join t_auditee_entities_maping m
            on ee.entity_id = m.entity_id
         inner join t_au_plan_status es
            on es.id = ep.status
        
         where ep.auditperiodid = P_ID
           and az.type_id = 9
           and not exists
         (select 'z'
                  from t_au_plan_eng ap
                 where ap.plan_id = ep.id
                   and ap.period_id = ep.auditperiodid);
    
    end if;
  end P_FAD_audit_Plan_Details;

  procedure P_AUDITED_BY_DEPARTMENTS(P_NO      in number,
                                     ENT_ID    in number,
                                     R_ID      in number,
                                     io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
  
    if (ENT_ID = 112243) then
      open io_cursor for
        select e.entity_id, e.name
          from t_audit_departments d
         inner join t_auditee_entities e
            on d.entity_id = e.entity_id
           and e.type_id = 9
        union
        select 0 as entity_id, 'All Audit Zones' as name
          from dual;
    
    else
      if (r_id in (1, 3, 5)) then
      
        open io_cursor for
          select e.entity_id, e.name
            from t_audit_departments d
           inner join t_auditee_entities e
              on d.entity_id = e.entity_id
             and e.type_id = 4;
      
      else
        open io_cursor for
          select e.entity_id, e.name
            from t_auditee_entities e
           where e.entity_id = ENT_ID;
      end if;
    end if;
  
  end P_AUDITED_BY_DEPARTMENTS;

  procedure R_FAD_ANNEXURE_REPORT(io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select s.ppno, s.name, s.audit_zone, s.total, s.Pending, s.Completed
        from v_fad_annexure_sum s;
  end R_FAD_ANNEXURE_REPORT;

  procedure R_GROUP_WISE_USERS_COUNT(io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select m.group_id as G_ID,
             g.group_name as G_NAME,
             count(m.userid) as U_COUNT
        from t_groups g
       inner join t_user_maping m
          on g.group_id = m.group_id
       group by m.group_id, g.group_name
       order by m.group_id asc;
  end R_GROUP_WISE_USERS_COUNT;

  procedure R_GROUP_WISE_PAGES(G_ID in number, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
  
    If (G_ID is null or G_ID in (0)) then
      open io_cursor for
        select gm.group_id  as G_ID,
               g.group_name as G_NAME,
               p.page_name  as P_NAME
          from t_groups g
         inner join t_menu_pages_groupmap gm
            on g.group_id = gm.group_id
        
         inner join t_menu_pages p
            on p.id = gm.page_id
         order by gm.group_id asc;
    else
      open io_cursor for
        select gm.group_id  as G_ID,
               g.group_name as G_NAME,
               p.page_name  as P_NAME
          from t_groups g
         inner join t_menu_pages_groupmap gm
            on g.group_id = gm.group_id
        
         inner join t_menu_pages p
            on p.id = gm.page_id
         where gm.group_id = G_ID
         order by gm.group_id asc;
    end if;
  end R_GROUP_WISE_PAGES;

  PROCEDURE R_DEPT_WISE_PARA_POSITION(P_NO        IN NUMBER,
                                      ENT_ID      IN NUMBER,
                                      R_ID        IN NUMBER,
                                      ENT_TYPE_ID IN NUMBER,
                                      io_cursor   OUT t_cursor,
                                      P_REF_DATE  IN DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE, -- as-of date
                                      P_USE_TRUNC IN NUMBER DEFAULT 0 -- 0 = index-friendly, 1 = TRUNC(column)
                                      ) AS
  BEGIN
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- BRANCH A: TYPE-WISE SUMMARY (roles: 1,2,5)
    -- Output: name=t.entitytypedesc, entity_id=e.type_id, age slab, total_paras
    -- Slabs are CALENDAR-YEAR based from c.para_added_on vs P_REF_DATE
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF R_ID IN (1, 2, 5) THEN
      IF P_USE_TRUNC = 0 THEN
        -- Index-friendly predicates (no TRUNC on columns)
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          WITH base AS
           (SELECT t.entitytypedesc AS name,
                   e.type_id AS entity_id,
                   c.com_id AS para_id,
                   CASE
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) =
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) THEN
                      'SLAB_1_CURRENT_YEAR'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 3 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 1 THEN
                      'SLAB_2_Age_1_to_3'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 6 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 4 THEN
                      'SLAB_3_Age_4_to_6'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 9 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 7 THEN
                      'SLAB_4_Age_7_to_9'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 12 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 10 THEN
                      'SLAB_5_Age_10_to_12'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) <=
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 13 THEN
                      'SLAB_6_Age_12_plus'
                   END AS age
              FROM ais_t_au_post_compliance c
              JOIN t_auditee_entities e
                ON e.entity_id = c.entity_id
              JOIN t_auditee_ent_types t
                ON t.autid = e.type_id
             WHERE t.audit_type = 'B'
               AND (ENT_TYPE_ID = -1 OR t.autid = ENT_TYPE_ID)
               AND c.para_status = 8
                  -- As-of cut-off (end of day): include created on/before, exclude settled on/before
               AND c.para_added_on < TRUNC(P_REF_DATE) + 1
               AND NVL(c.setteled_on, DATE '9999-12-31') >=
                   TRUNC(P_REF_DATE) + 1)
          SELECT name,
                 entity_id,
                 age,
                 COUNT(DISTINCT para_id) AS total_paras
            FROM base
           GROUP BY name, entity_id, age
           ORDER BY entity_id, age;ELSE
        -- TRUNC(column) version
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          WITH base AS
           (SELECT t.entitytypedesc AS name,
                   e.type_id AS entity_id,
                   c.com_id AS para_id,
                   CASE
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) =
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) THEN
                      'SLAB_1_CURRENT_YEAR'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 3 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 1 THEN
                      'SLAB_2_Age_1_to_3'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 6 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 4 THEN
                      'SLAB_3_Age_4_to_6'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 9 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 7 THEN
                      'SLAB_4_Age_7_to_9'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 12 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 10 THEN
                      'SLAB_5_Age_10_to_12'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) <=
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 13 THEN
                      'SLAB_6_Age_12_plus'
                   END AS age
              FROM ais_t_au_post_compliance c
              JOIN t_auditee_entities e
                ON e.entity_id = c.entity_id
              JOIN t_auditee_ent_types t
                ON t.autid = e.type_id
             WHERE t.audit_type = 'B'
               AND (ENT_TYPE_ID = -1 OR
                   t.autid = ENT_TYPE_ID)
               AND c.para_status = 8
                  -- TRUNC-based as-of (calendar-day inclusive)
               AND TRUNC(c.para_added_on) <=
                   TRUNC(P_REF_DATE)
               AND NVL(TRUNC(c.setteled_on),
                       DATE '9999-12-31') >
                   TRUNC(P_REF_DATE))
          SELECT name,
                 entity_id,
                 age,
                 COUNT(DISTINCT para_id) AS total_paras
            FROM base
           GROUP BY name, entity_id, age
           ORDER BY entity_id, age;
      END IF;
    
      ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      -- BRANCH B: ENTITY-WISE SUMMARY for specific auditor (ENT_ID = 112248)
      -- Source example: ais_t_au_post_compliance
      -- Same calendar-year slab logic against c.para_added_on
      ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    ELSIF ENT_ID IN (112248) THEN
      IF P_USE_TRUNC = 0 THEN
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          WITH categorized AS
           (SELECT c.com_id,
                   c.entity_id,
                   CASE
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM trunc(c.para_added_on)) =
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM trunc(P_REF_DATE)) THEN
                      'SLAB_1_CURRENT_YEAR'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 3 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 1 THEN
                      'SLAB_2_Age_1_to_3'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 6 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 4 THEN
                      'SLAB_3_Age_4_to_6'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 9 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 7 THEN
                      'SLAB_4_Age_7_to_9'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 12 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 10 THEN
                      'SLAB_5_Age_10_to_12'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) <=
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 13 THEN
                      'SLAB_6_Age_12_plus'
                   END AS age
              FROM ais_t_au_post_compliance c
             WHERE c.audited_by = ENT_ID
               AND c.para_status = 8
            -- AND c.para_added_on <  TRUNC(P_REF_DATE) + 1
            --AND NVL(c.settled_on, DATE '9999-12-31') >= TRUNC(P_REF_DATE) + 1
            )
          SELECT e.entity_id,
                 e.name,
                 age,
                 COUNT(DISTINCT com_id) AS total_paras
            FROM categorized x
            JOIN t_auditee_entities e
              ON e.entity_id = x.entity_id
           GROUP BY e.entity_id, e.name, age
           ORDER BY e.name, age;ELSE
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          WITH categorized AS
           (SELECT c.com_id,
                   c.entity_id,
                   CASE
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) =
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) THEN
                      'SLAB_1_CURRENT_YEAR'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 3 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 1 THEN
                      'SLAB_2_Age_1_to_3'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 6 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 4 THEN
                      'SLAB_3_Age_4_to_6'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 9 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 7 THEN
                      'SLAB_4_Age_7_to_9'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 12 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 10 THEN
                      'SLAB_5_Age_10_to_12'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) <=
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 13 THEN
                      'SLAB_6_Age_12_plus'
                   END AS age
              FROM ais_t_au_post_compliance c
             WHERE c.audited_by = ENT_ID
               AND c.para_status = 8
               AND TRUNC(c.para_added_on) <=
                   TRUNC(P_REF_DATE)
               AND NVL(TRUNC(c.setteled_on),
                       DATE '9999-12-31') >
                   TRUNC(P_REF_DATE))
          SELECT e.entity_id,
                 e.name,
                 age,
                 COUNT(DISTINCT com_id) AS total_paras
            FROM categorized x
            JOIN t_auditee_entities e
              ON e.entity_id = x.entity_id
           GROUP BY e.entity_id, e.name, age
           ORDER BY e.name, age;
      END IF;
    
      ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      -- BRANCH C: DEFAULT ENTITY-WISE SUMMARY (same calendar-year slab logic)
      ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    ELSE
      IF P_USE_TRUNC = 0 THEN
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          WITH base AS
           (SELECT e.entity_id,
                   e.name,
                   c.com_id AS para_id,
                   CASE
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) =
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) THEN
                      'SLAB_1_CURRENT_YEAR'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 3 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 1 THEN
                      'SLAB_2_Age_1_to_3'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 6 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 4 THEN
                      'SLAB_3_Age_4_to_6'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 9 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 7 THEN
                      'SLAB_4_Age_7_to_9'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 12 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 10 THEN
                      'SLAB_5_Age_10_to_12'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.para_added_on) <=
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM P_REF_DATE) - 13 THEN
                      'SLAB_6_Age_12_plus'
                   END AS age
              FROM ais_t_au_post_compliance c
              JOIN t_auditee_entities e
                ON e.entity_id = c.entity_id
              JOIN t_auditee_ent_types t
                ON t.autid = e.type_id
             WHERE (ENT_TYPE_ID = -1 OR t.autid = ENT_TYPE_ID)
               AND c.para_status = 8
               AND c.para_added_on < TRUNC(P_REF_DATE) + 1
               AND NVL(c.setteled_on, DATE '9999-12-31') >=
                   TRUNC(P_REF_DATE) + 1)
          SELECT entity_id,
                 name,
                 age,
                 COUNT(DISTINCT para_id) AS total_paras
            FROM base
           GROUP BY entity_id, name, age
           ORDER BY name, age;ELSE
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          WITH base AS
           (SELECT e.entity_id,
                   e.name,
                   c.com_id AS para_id,
                   CASE
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) =
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) THEN
                      'SLAB_1_CURRENT_YEAR'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 3 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 1 THEN
                      'SLAB_2_Age_1_to_3'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 6 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 4 THEN
                      'SLAB_3_Age_4_to_6'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 9 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 7 THEN
                      'SLAB_4_Age_7_to_9'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) BETWEEN
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 12 AND
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 10 THEN
                      'SLAB_5_Age_10_to_12'
                     WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  c.para_added_on) <=
                          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM
                                  P_REF_DATE) - 13 THEN
                      'SLAB_6_Age_12_plus'
                   END AS age
              FROM ais_t_au_post_compliance c
              JOIN t_auditee_entities e
                ON e.entity_id = c.entity_id
              JOIN t_auditee_ent_types t
                ON t.autid = e.type_id
             WHERE (ENT_TYPE_ID = -1 OR
                   t.autid = ENT_TYPE_ID)
               AND c.para_status = 8
               AND TRUNC(c.para_added_on) <=
                   TRUNC(P_REF_DATE)
               AND NVL(TRUNC(c.setteled_on),
                       DATE '9999-12-31') >
                   TRUNC(P_REF_DATE))
          SELECT entity_id,
                 name,
                 age,
                 COUNT(DISTINCT para_id) AS total_paras
            FROM base
           GROUP BY entity_id, name, age
           ORDER BY name, age;
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END R_DEPT_WISE_PARA_POSITION;

  Procedure R_get_gm_list(io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select e.entity_id, e.code, e.name, e.auditby_id
        from t_auditee_entities e
       where e.type_id = 21;
  end R_get_gm_list;

  Procedure R_get_rbh_list(gm in number, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select e.entity_id,
             e.child_code as code,
             e.c_name     as name,
             e.auditedby  as auditby_id
        from t_auditee_entities_maping e
       where e.parent_id = case
               when gm = 0 then
                e.parent_id
               else
                gm
             end
         and e.c_type_id = 5
         and e.status = 'Y';
  end R_get_rbh_list;

  Procedure R_get_branch_list(rbh       in number,
                              audit_by  in number,
                              io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      select e.entity_id,
             e.child_code as code,
             e.c_name     as name,
             e.auditedby  as auditby_id
        from t_auditee_entities_maping e
       where e.parent_id = rbh;
  end R_get_branch_list;

      /*      select s.glsubcode, s.glsubname, s.branchid
       from atas.t_glsub@prodro.l1.local s
      where s.active = 'Y'*/
      ;
  end p_get_loan_gl;

        from TEMP_ATAS_T_DISB_STATUS t
