      ;
  end p_get_loan_status;

  procedure p_get_loan_to_default(g_id       number,
                                  l_status   number,
                                  start_date date,
                                  end_date   date,
                                  ent_id     number,
                                  io_cursor  OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
  
    if (g_id != 0 and l_status != 0) then
      open io_cursor for
        select *
          from V_ATAS_T_LOAN_CNIC_WISE l
         where l.disb_date between start_date and end_date
           and l.glsubcode = g_id
           and l.parent_id = ent_id
           and exists (select 'z'
                  from v_atas_loans_default n
                 where n.cnic = l.cnic
                   and n.current_status = l_status);
    else
      if (g_id != 0 and l_status = 0) then
        open io_cursor for
          select l.cnic,
                 l.parent_id,
                 l.p_name,
                 l.entity_id,
                 l.c_name,
                 l.loan_case_no,
                 l.customername,
                 l.glsubcode,
                 l.glsubname,
                 l.loan_disb_id,
                 l.disb_date,
                 l.last_transaction_date,
                 l.valid_until,
                 l.last_recovery_amount,
                 l.disb_status as disb_statusid,
                 l.previous_disb_statusid,
                 l.prin,
                 l.markup
            from V_ATAS_T_LOAN_CNIC_WISE l
           where l.disb_date between start_date and end_date
             and l.glsubcode = g_id
             and l.parent_id = ent_id;
      else
        if (g_id = 0 and l_status != 0) then
          open io_cursor for
            select l.cnic,
                   l.parent_id,
                   l.p_name,
                   l.entity_id,
                   l.c_name,
                   l.loan_case_no,
                   l.customername,
                   l.glsubcode,
                   l.glsubname,
                   l.loan_disb_id,
                   l.disb_date,
                   l.last_transaction_date,
                   l.valid_until,
                   l.last_recovery_amount,
                   l.disb_status as disb_statusid,
                   l.previous_disb_statusid,
                   l.prin,
                   l.markup
              from V_ATAS_T_LOAN_CNIC_WISE l
             where l.disb_date between start_date and end_date
               and l.parent_id = ent_id
               and exists (select 'z'
                      from v_atas_loans_default n
                     where n.cnic = l.cnic
                       and n.current_status = l_status);
        else
          open io_cursor for
            select l.cnic,
                   l.parent_id,
                   l.p_name,
                   l.entity_id,
                   l.c_name,
                   l.loan_case_no,
                   l.customername,
                   l.glsubcode,
                   l.glsubname,
                   l.loan_disb_id,
                   l.disb_date,
                   l.last_transaction_date,
                   l.valid_until,
                   l.last_recovery_amount,
                   l.disb_status as disb_statusid,
                   l.previous_disb_statusid,
                   l.prin,
                   l.markup
              from V_ATAS_T_LOAN_CNIC_WISE l
             where l.disb_date between start_date and end_date
               and l.parent_id = ent_id;
        end if;
      end if;
    end if;
  
  end p_get_loan_to_default;

  procedure p_get_all_loans_of_cnic(c_nic     in number,
                                    io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
    open io_cursor for
      SELECT A.CNIC,
             A.PARENT_ID,
             A.P_NAME,
             A.ENTITY_ID,
             A.C_NAME,
             A.LOAN_CASE_NO,
             A.CUSTOMERNAME,
             A.GLSUBCODE,
             A.GLSUBNAME,
             A.LOAN_DISB_ID,
             A.DISB_DATE,
             A.LAST_TRANSACTION_DATE,
             A.VALID_UNTIL,
             A.LAST_RECOVERY_AMOUNT,
             A.DISB_STATUS as DISB_STATUSID,
             A.PRIN,
             A.MARKUP
        FROM V_ATAS_T_LOAN_CNIC_WISE A
       where a.cnic = c_nic;
  
  end p_get_all_loans_of_cnic;

  procedure p_get_loan_to_default_history(c_nic     in number,
                                          dis_id    in number,
                                          io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
  
    open io_cursor for
      SELECT nvl(l.loan_disb_id, 0) as npl_loan_disb_id,
             nvl(l.default_principal, 0) as default_principal,
             nvl(l.default_markup, 0) as default_markup,
             nvl(l.outstanding_principal_total, 0) as outstanding_principal_total,
             nvl(l.outstanding_markup_total, 0) as outstanding_markup_total,
             nvl(s.description, 0) as current_status,
             (case
               when l.transaction_date = null then
                sysdate
               else
                l.transaction_date
             end) as transaction_date,
             (case
               when l.record_timestamp = null then
                sysdate
               else
                l.record_timestamp
             end) as record_timestamp,
             nvl(l.cnic, 0) as cnic,
             nvl(l.loan_disb_id, 0) as loan_disb_id
        FROM v_atas_loans_default L
       inner join temp_atas_t_disb_status s
          on s.accountstatusid = l.current_status
       WHERE L.CNIC = C_NIC
            --and l.loan_disb_id = dis_id
         and l.loan_disb_id = dis_id;
  
  end p_get_loan_to_default_history;

  procedure P_find_gist(gst varchar2, io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
  
    open io_cursor for
      select az.name as audit_zone,
             m.p_name as Region,
             e.name as branch,
             e.code as branch_code,
             trunc(fd.entereddate) entereddate,
             g.para_no,
             nvl(n.code, '-') as annex,
             g.gist_of_paras,
             nvl(g.no_of_instances, 0) no_of_instances,
             nvl(g.amount_involved, '-') amount_involved
      
        from t_auditee_entities e
       inner join t_auditee_entities_maping m
          on m.entity_id = e.entity_id
       inner join t_auditee_entities az
          on az.entity_id = e.auditby_id
       inner join t_au_observation_fad fd
          on fd.entity_id = e.entity_id
       inner join V_GET_PARA_GIST g
          on g.entity_id = fd.entity_id
         and g.IND = fd.IND
         and ((g.para_id = fd.old_para_id and fd.IND = 'O') or
             (g.para_id = fd.new_paraid and fd.IND = 'A'))
       inner join t_audit_checklist_annexure n
          on n.id = g.annex
       where upper(g.gist_of_paras) like ('%' || upper(gst) || '%');
  
  end P_find_gist;

  Procedure P_GET_COM_PROGREE_REPORT(R_TYPE    Varchar2,
                                     io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
    if (R_TYPE = 'A') then
      open io_cursor for
        select a.APPROVER_PPNO as PP_NO,
               a.Approver_name as Name,
               a.Total,
               a.Referred_Back,
               a.Settled as Recommended,
               (case
                 when (a.total - a.Settled - a.Referred_Back) < 0 then
                  0
                 else
                  (a.total - a.Settled - a.Referred_Back)
               end) as pending,
               (select max(s.logged_in_date)
                  from t_user_session s
                 where s.user_pp_number = a.APPROVER_PPNO) as last_login
        
          from v_get_compliance_progress_APPROVER a;
    else
    
      open io_cursor for
        select r.REVIEWER_PPNO as PP_NO,
               r.Reviewer_name as Name,
               r.Total,
               r.Referred_Back,
               r.Recommended,
               (case
                 when (r.total - r.Recommended - r.Referred_Back) < 0 then
                  0
                 else
                  (r.total - r.Recommended - r.Referred_Back)
               end) as pending,
               (select max(s.logged_in_date)
                  from t_user_session s
                 where s.user_pp_number = r.REVIEWER_PPNO) as last_login
        
          from v_get_compliance_progress_reviewer r;
    
    end if;
  
  end P_GET_COM_PROGREE_REPORT;

  Procedure P_GET_COM_PROGREE_REPORT_DETAIL(R_TYPE    Varchar2,
                                            P_NO      number,
                                            io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
    if (R_TYPE = 'A') then
      open io_cursor for
        select a.Compliance_Unit,
               a.parent_id,
               a.p_name,
               a.entity_id,
               a.entity_id as code,
               a.name,
               a.COM_KEY,
               a.APPROVER_PPNO as PP_NO,
               a.Approver_name as emp_name,
               a.total,
               a.Satisfied,
               a.Refered_back,
               (case
                 when (a.total - a.Satisfied - a.Refered_back) < 0 then
                  0
                 else
                  (a.total - a.Satisfied - a.Refered_back)
               end) as pending
        
          from v_get_compliance_progress_approver_details a
         where a.APPROVER_PPNO = P_NO;
    else
    
      open io_cursor for
        select r.Compliance_Unit,
               r.parent_id,
               r.p_name,
               r.entity_id,
               r.entity_id as code,
               r.name,
               r.COM_KEY,
               r.REVIEWER_PPNO as PP_NO,
               r.Reviewer_name as emp_name,
               r.total,
               r.Recommended as Satisfied,
               r.Referred_Back as Refered_back,
               (case
                 when (r.total - r.Recommended - r.Referred_Back) < 0 then
                  0
                 else
                  (r.total - r.Recommended - r.Referred_Back)
               end) as pending
        
          from v_get_compliance_progress_reviewer_details r
         where r.REVIEWER_PPNO = P_NO;
    
    end if;
  
  end P_GET_COM_PROGREE_REPORT_DETAIL;

  Procedure P_GET_ENTITIES_FOR_COMPLIANCE_REPORT(ENT_ID    number,
                                                 R_ID      number,
                                                 P_NO      number,
                                                 io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  begin
    if (R_ID in (1)) then
      open io_cursor for
        select distinct f.entity_id, e.name
          from v_get_settlement_report f
         inner join t_auditee_entities e
            on f.entity_id = e.entity_id
         order by e.name asc;
    else
    
      If (R_ID in (5)) then
        open io_cursor for
          select distinct f.entity_id, e.name
            from v_get_settlement_report f
           inner join t_auditee_entities e
              on f.entity_id = e.entity_id
           where f.auditedby IN
                 (select m.entity_id
                    from t_Auditee_Entities_Maping m
                   where m.parent_id = ENT_ID)
           order by e.name asc;
      
      else
        if (R_ID in (21, 39)) then
          open io_cursor for
            select distinct f.entity_id, e.name
              from v_get_settlement_report f
             inner join t_auditee_entities e
                on f.entity_id = e.entity_id
             where f.entity_id = ENT_ID
                or (F.entity_id in
                   (select m.entity_id
                       from t_auditee_entities_maping m
                      where m.parent_id = ENT_ID))
             order by e.name asc;
        else
        
          if (R_ID in (15, 16)) then
            open io_cursor for
              select distinct f.entity_id, e.name
                from v_get_settlement_report f
               inner join t_auditee_entities e
                  on f.entity_id = e.entity_id
               Where f.auditedby = ENT_ID
               order by e.name asc;
          
          else
            if (R_ID in (41)) then
              open io_cursor for
                select distinct f.entity_id, e.name
                
                  from v_get_settlement_report f
                 inner join t_auditee_entities e
                    on f.entity_id = e.entity_id
                 where f.entity_id in
                       (select e.entity_id
                          from t_auditee_entities e
                         where e.compliance_unit in
                               (select cm.Entity_Id
                                  from t_auditee_entities_maping_com cm))
                 order by e.name asc;
            
            else
            
              if (R_ID in (43)) then
                open io_cursor for
                  select distinct f.entity_id, e.name
                    from v_get_settlement_report f
                   inner join t_auditee_entities e
                      on f.entity_id = e.entity_id
                   where f.entity_id in
                         (select e.entity_id
                            from t_auditee_entities e
                           where e.compliance_unit in
                                 (select cm.Entity_Id
                                    from t_auditee_entities_maping_com cm
                                   where cm.reviewer_ppno = P_NO))
                   order by e.name asc;
              
              else
                if (R_ID in (44)) then
                  open io_cursor for
                    select distinct f.entity_id, e.name
                      from v_get_settlement_report f
                     inner join t_auditee_entities e
                        on f.entity_id = e.entity_id
                     where f.entity_id in
                           (select e.entity_id
                              from t_auditee_entities e
                             where e.compliance_unit in
                                   (select cm.Entity_Id
                                      from t_auditee_entities_maping_com cm
                                     where cm.approver_ppno = P_NO))
                     order by e.name asc;
                else
                  if (R_ID in (12, 13)) then
                    open io_cursor for
                      select distinct f.entity_id, e.name
                        from v_get_settlement_report f
                       inner join t_auditee_entities e
                          on e.entity_id = f.entity_id
                       where f.entity_id = ENT_ID;
                  else
                    if (R_ID in (40)) then
                      open io_cursor for
                        select distinct f.entity_id, e.name
                          from v_get_settlement_report f
                         inner join t_auditee_entities e
                            on e.entity_id = f.entity_id
                         where f.entity_id = ENT_ID;
                    end if;
                  end if;
                end if;
              end if;
            end if;
          end if;
        end if;
      end if;
    end if;
  
  end P_GET_ENTITIES_FOR_COMPLIANCE_REPORT;

  PROCEDURE P_GET_ENTITY_TYPE_FOR_SETTLEMENT(R_ID      NUMBER,
                                             ENT_ID    NUMBER,
                                             P_NO      NUMBER,
                                             io_cursor OUT t_cursor) AS
    T_F NUMBER := 0;
  BEGIN
    SELECT NVL(MAX(e.type_id), 0)
      INTO T_F
      FROM t_auditee_entities e
     WHERE e.entity_id = ENT_ID;
  
    CASE
      WHEN R_ID IN (1, 5, 6, 7) THEN
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          SELECT t.autid, t.entitytypedesc FROM t_auditee_ent_types t;
      
      WHEN R_ID = 9 THEN
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          SELECT t.autid, t.entitytypedesc
            FROM t_auditee_ent_types t
           WHERE t.audited_by_enitity = ENT_ID;
      
      WHEN R_ID = 39 THEN
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          SELECT t.autid, t.entitytypedesc
            FROM t_auditee_ent_types t
           WHERE t.autid IN (5, 6, 20, 21, 28);
      
      WHEN R_ID IN (15, 16, 21) THEN
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          SELECT t.autid, t.entitytypedesc
            FROM t_auditee_ent_types t
           WHERE t.autid IN (5, 6, 28, 25);
      
      WHEN R_ID IN (14, 24, 12, 13) THEN
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          SELECT t.autid, t.entitytypedesc
            FROM t_auditee_ent_types t
           WHERE t.autid = T_F;
      
      WHEN R_ID IN (43, 44, 45) THEN
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          SELECT t.autid, t.entitytypedesc
            FROM t_auditee_ent_types t
           WHERE t.autid = 6;
      
      WHEN R_ID = 40 THEN
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          SELECT t.autid, t.entitytypedesc
            FROM t_auditee_ent_types t
           WHERE t.autid IN
                 (CASE WHEN ENT_ID = 112247 THEN 6 WHEN ENT_ID = 112262 THEN 25 ELSE NULL END);
      
      ELSE
        -- default fallback (optional)
        OPEN io_cursor FOR
          SELECT t.autid, t.entitytypedesc
            FROM t_auditee_ent_types t
           WHERE 1 = 0; -- no result by default
    END CASE;
  END P_GET_ENTITY_TYPE_FOR_SETTLEMENT;

  Procedure P_GET_COMPLIANCE_REPORT(ENT_ID      number,
                                    S_ENT_ID    number,
                                    S_DATE_FROM date,
                                    S_DATE_TO   date,
                                    R_ID        number,
                                    P_NO        number,
                                    io_cursor   OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
  
    if (R_ID in (1, 5, 6, 7)) then
      open io_cursor for
        SELECT f.parent_id,
               f.p_name,
               f.c_name,
               f.entity_id,
               f.auditedby,
               f.period,
               f.para_no,
               f.Gist,
               TO_CHAR(f.stelled_on, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as setteled_on
          FROM v_get_settlement_report f
         WHERE f.c_type_id = CASE
                 WHEN S_ENT_ID = 0 THEN
                  f.c_type_id
                 ELSE
                  S_ENT_ID
               END
           and f.stelled_on between S_DATE_FROM and S_DATE_TO;
    
    else
      if (R_ID in (39)) then
        open io_cursor for
          select f.parent_id,
                 f.p_name,
                 f.c_name,
                 f.entity_id,
                 f.auditedby,
                 f.period,
                 f.para_no,
                 f.Gist,
                 f.stelled_on as setteled_on
            from v_get_settlement_report f
           INNER JOIN T_AUDITEE_ENTITIES_MAPING M
              ON (M.ENTITY_ID = F.entity_id OR m.entity_id = F.parent_id)
            left JOIN T_AUDITEE_ENTITIES_MAPING MM
              ON MM.ENTITY_ID = M.PARENT_ID
           where (MM.ENTITY_ID = ent_id or f.entity_id = ent_id)
             and f.stelled_on between S_DATE_FROM and S_DATE_TO
             AND F.AUTID = CASE
                   WHEN S_ENT_ID = 0 THEN
                    F.AUTID
                   ELSE
                    S_ENT_ID
                 END
           ORDER BY F.AUTID;
      
      else
        if (R_ID in (15, 16)) then
          open io_cursor for
            select f.parent_id,
                   f.p_name,
                   f.c_name,
                   f.entity_id,
                   f.auditedby,
                   f.period,
                   f.para_no,
                   f.Gist,
                   f.stelled_on as setteled_on
              from v_get_settlement_report f
             where f.AUDIT_BY_ID = ENT_ID
               and f.c_type_id = CASE
                     WHEN S_ENT_ID = 0 THEN
                      f.c_type_id
                     ELSE
                      S_ENT_ID
                   END
                  
               and f.stelled_on between S_DATE_FROM and S_DATE_TO
             ORDER BY F.AUTID;
        else
          if (R_ID in (43)) then
            open io_cursor for
              select f.parent_id,
                     f.p_name,
                     f.c_name,
                     f.entity_id,
                     f.auditedby,
                     f.period,
                     f.para_no,
                     f.Gist,
                     f.stelled_on as setteled_on
              
                from v_get_settlement_report f
               where f.entity_id in
                     (select e.entity_id
                        from t_auditee_entities e
                       where e.compliance_unit in
                             (select cm.Entity_Id
                                from t_auditee_entities_maping_com cm
                               where cm.reviewer_ppno = P_NO))
                 and f.c_type_id = CASE
                       WHEN S_ENT_ID = 0 THEN
                        f.c_type_id
                       ELSE
                        S_ENT_ID
                     END
                 and f.stelled_on between S_DATE_FROM and S_DATE_TO;
          
          else
            if (R_ID in (44)) then
              open io_cursor for
                select f.parent_id,
                       f.p_name,
                       f.c_name,
                       f.entity_id,
                       f.auditedby,
                       f.period,
                       f.para_no,
                       f.Gist,
                       f.stelled_on as setteled_on
                
                  from v_get_settlement_report f
                 where f.entity_id in
                       (select e.entity_id
                          from t_auditee_entities e
                         where e.compliance_unit in
                               (select cm.Entity_Id
                                  from t_auditee_entities_maping_com cm
                                 where cm.approver_ppno = P_NO))
                   and f.c_type_id = CASE
                         WHEN S_ENT_ID = 0 THEN
                          f.c_type_id
                         ELSE
                          S_ENT_ID
                       END
                   and f.stelled_on between S_DATE_FROM and S_DATE_TO
                 ORDER BY F.AUTID;
            else
              if (R_ID in (21)) then
                open io_cursor for
                  select f.parent_id,
                         f.p_name,
                         f.c_name,
                         f.entity_id,
                         f.auditedby,
                         f.period,
                         f.para_no,
                         f.Gist,
                         f.stelled_on as setteled_on
                  
                    from v_get_settlement_report f
                   where (f.entity_id in
                         (select cm.Entity_Id
                             from t_auditee_entities_maping cm
                            where cm.parent_id = ENT_ID) or
                         f.entity_id = ENT_ID)
                     AND F.AUTID = CASE
                           WHEN S_ENT_ID = 0 THEN
                            F.AUTID
                           ELSE
                            S_ENT_ID
                         END
                        
                     and f.stelled_on between S_DATE_FROM and S_DATE_TO
                   ORDER BY F.AUTID;
              else
                if (R_ID in (40)) then
                  open io_cursor for
                    select f.parent_id,
                           f.p_name,
                           f.c_name,
                           f.entity_id,
                           f.auditedby,
                           f.period,
                           f.para_no,
                           f.Gist,
                           f.stelled_on as setteled_on
                    
                      from v_get_settlement_report f
                     where f.AUTID in case
                             when ENT_ID = 112247 then
                              5
                             when ENT_ID = 112262 then
                              25
                           end
                        or F.AUTID IN case
                             when ENT_ID = 112247 then
                              6
                           end
                       and f.stelled_on between S_DATE_FROM and S_DATE_TO
                     ORDER BY F.AUTID;
                else
                  open io_cursor for
                    select f.parent_id,
                           f.p_name,
                           f.c_name,
                           f.entity_id,
                           f.auditedby,
                           f.period,
                           f.para_no,
                           f.Gist,
                           f.stelled_on as setteled_on
                      from v_get_settlement_report f
                     where f.entity_id = ENT_ID
                       and f.stelled_on between S_DATE_FROM and S_DATE_TO;
                end if;
              end if;
            end if;
          end if;
        end if;
      end if;
    end if;
  end P_GET_COMPLIANCE_REPORT;

  Procedure P_GET_PARA_POSITION_SUM(ENT_ID    number,
                                    R_ID      number,
                                    P_NO      number,
                                    io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  
  begin
  
    if (R_ID in (1, 5, 7)) then
      open io_cursor for
        SELECT 0 as parent_id,
               '' as p_name,
               0 as entity_id,
               f.ent_type as ent_name,
               f.ent_type,
               sum(f.t_paras) as t_paras,
               sum(f.t_s_paras) as t_s_paras,
               sum(f.t_os_paras) as t_os_paras,
               sum(f.z_cos_paras) as z_cos_paras
          FROM v_get_rpt_para_poistion f
         group by f.ent_type;
    else
      if (R_ID in (13, 12)) then
        open io_cursor for
          select f.parent_id,
                 f.p_name,
                 f.ent_name,
                 f.entity_id,
                 sum(f.t_paras) as t_paras,
                 sum(f.t_s_paras) as t_s_paras,
                 sum(f.t_os_paras) as t_os_paras,
                 sum(f.z_cos_paras) as z_cos_paras
            FROM v_get_rpt_para_poistion f
           where f.entity_id = ENT_ID
           group by f.parent_id, f.p_name, f.ent_name, f.entity_id;
      else
        if (R_ID in (15, 16)) then
          open io_cursor for
            select f.parent_id,
                   f.p_name,
                   f.ent_name,
                   f.entity_id,
                   sum(f.t_paras) as t_paras,
                   sum(f.t_s_paras) as t_s_paras,
                   sum(f.t_os_paras) as t_os_paras,
                   sum(f.z_cos_paras) as z_cos_paras
              FROM v_get_rpt_para_poistion f
             inner join t_auditee_entities e
                on e.entity_id = f.entity_id
             where e.auditby_id = ENT_ID
             group by f.parent_id, f.p_name, f.ent_name, f.entity_id;
        else
          if (R_ID = 40 and ENT_ID = 112247) then
            OPEN io_cursor FOR
              select 0 as parent_id,
                     m.p_name,
                     m.c_name as ent_name,
                     0 as entity_id,
                     '' as ent_type,
                     sum(f.t_paras) as t_paras,
                     sum(f.t_s_paras) as t_s_paras,
                     sum(f.t_os_paras) as t_os_paras,
                     sum(f.z_cos_paras) as z_cos_paras
                FROM v_get_rpt_para_poistion_regions f
               inner join t_auditee_entities_maping m
                  on m.entity_id = f.entity_id
                 and m.c_type_id = 5
               group by m.p_name, m.c_name;
          
          else
            if (R_ID = 40 and ENT_ID = 112262) then
              OPEN io_cursor FOR
                select f.parent_id,
                       f.p_name,
                       f.ent_name,
                       f.entity_id,
                       '' as ent_type,
                       sum(f.t_paras) as t_paras,
                       sum(f.t_s_paras) as t_s_paras,
                       sum(f.t_os_paras) as t_os_paras,
                       sum(f.z_cos_paras) as z_cos_paras
                  FROM v_get_rpt_para_poistion f
                 where f.ENTITY_TYPE_ID = 25
                 group by f.parent_id, f.p_name, f.ent_name, f.entity_id;
            
            end if;
          
          end if;
        end if;
      
      end if;
    end if;
  
  end P_GET_PARA_POSITION_SUM;

  Procedure p_delay_audits(P_NO      number,
                           ENT_ID    NUMBER,
                           R_ID      NUMBER,
                           io_cursor OUT t_cursor) as
  BEGIN
    OPEN IO_CURSOR FOR
      select e.entity_id,
             e.name,
             m.p_name,
             m.c_name,
             p.audit_startdate,
             p.audit_enddate,
             p.status as status_id,
             s.status,
             (trunc(sysdate) - p.audit_enddate) as no_of_days
        from t_au_plan_eng p
       inner join t_auditee_entities e
          on e.entity_id = p.auditby_id
       inner join t_auditee_entities_maping m
          on p.entity_id = m.entity_id
       inner join t_au_plan_eng_status s
          on p.status = s.id
       inner join t_auditee_entities_maping fad
          on fad.entity_id = e.entity_id
       where p.status between 4 and 13
         and (p.audit_enddate + 15) < trunc(sysdate)
         AND ENT_ID = CASE
               WHEN R_ID in (6, 7) then
                p.auditby_id
               when R_ID = 5 then
                fad.parent_id
               when R_ID = 1 then
                ENT_ID
               when R_ID = 15 then
                p.auditby_id
             end;
  
  END p_delay_audits;

  Procedure RPT_P_GET_COMPLIANCE_STATUS_WISE(P_NO       in number,
                                             ENT_ID     in number,
                                             R_ID       in number,
                                             R_C        in varchar2,
                                             auditee_id in number,
                                             S_Date     in date,
                                             E_Date     in date,
                                             io_cursor  OUT t_cursor) is
  begin
  
    open io_cursor for
      select r.parent_id,
             r.Parent_Office,
             r.entity_id,
             r.entity_name,
             r.auditby_id,
             count(f.com_id) as Total_para,
             sum(case
                   when f.com_cycle != 0 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Total_Comp,
             sum(case
                   when f.com_status = 10 and f.com_stage = 21 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as AT_reporting,
             sum(case
                   when f.com_stage = 43 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Settlement_Officer,
             sum(case
                   when f.com_stage = 44 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Incharge_Comp,
             sum(case
                   when f.com_stage = 45 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Settled,
             sum(case
                   when f.cau_status in (12, 14, 18) then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as Referred_back,
             sum(case
                   when f.com_cycle = 0 then
                    1
                   else
                    0
                 end) as No_Compliance_Submitted
      
        from Ais_t_Au_Post_Compliance f
       inner join t_au_observation_status s
          on f.para_status = s.statusid
       inner join t_auditee_entities e
          on e.entity_id = f.entity_id
       inner join v_relationship_office r
          on r.entity_id = f.entity_id
       where auditee_id = (case
               when R_C = 'P' then
                r.parent_id
               else
                (case
                  when R_C = 'C' then
                   r.entity_id
                  else
                   auditee_id
                end)
             end)
         and exists
       (select 'z'
                from ais_t_au_post_compliance_history h
               where h.com_id = f.com_id
                 and h.com_status = 10
                 and trunc(h.comment_on) between S_Date and E_Date)
       group by r.parent_id,
                r.Parent_Office,
                r.entity_id,
                r.entity_name,
                r.auditby_id;
  end RPT_P_GET_COMPLIANCE_STATUS_WISE;

  PROCEDURE R_FAD_MONTHLY_REVIEW(P_NO      IN NUMBER,
                                 ENT_ID    IN NUMBER,
                                 R_ID      IN NUMBER,
                                 R_T       IN NUMBER,
                                 S_Date    IN DATE,
                                 E_Date    IN DATE,
                                 io_cursor OUT t_cursor) IS
  BEGIN
    IF (R_ID IN (1, 3, 5) AND R_T = -1) THEN
      OPEN io_cursor FOR
        SELECT '-' AS p_name,
               v.autid AS child_code,
               v.entitytypedesc AS c_name,
               v.audit_type,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN (TRUNC(v.para_added_on) < S_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.setteled_on) >= S_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.para_added_on) < S_Date AND v.para_status = 8) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) opening_bal,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(v.para_added_on) BETWEEN S_Date AND E_Date THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) Para_added,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(v.setteled_on) BETWEEN S_Date AND E_Date AND
                          v.para_status != 8 AND v.com_stage IN (41, 45) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) Settled_com,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(v.setteled_on) BETWEEN S_Date AND E_Date AND
                          v.para_status != 8 AND v.com_stage NOT IN (41, 45) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) Settled_aud,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date AND
                          v.para_status = 8)) THEN
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   END) Outstanding,
               -- R1
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((v.audit_type = 'D' AND v.risk = '1' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date))) OR
                          (v.audit_type = 'B' AND v.annex_risk = '1' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date)))) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS R1,
               -- R2
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((v.audit_type = 'D' AND v.risk = '2' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date))) OR
                          (v.audit_type = 'B' AND v.annex_risk = '2' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date)))) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS R2,
               -- R3
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((v.audit_type = 'D' AND v.risk in ('3', 0) AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date))) OR
                          (v.audit_type = 'B' AND v.annex_risk = '3' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date)))) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS R3
          FROM V_RPT_FAD_MONTHLY_BASE v
         WHERE v.audit_type IN ('B', 'D')
         GROUP BY v.autid, v.entitytypedesc, v.audit_type
         ORDER BY child_code;
    
    ELSIF R_ID IN (6, 7) THEN
      OPEN io_cursor FOR
        SELECT v.p_name,
               v.entity_id AS child_code,
               v.c_name,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN (TRUNC(v.para_added_on) < S_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.setteled_on) >= S_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.para_added_on) < S_Date AND v.para_status = 8) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) opening_bal,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(v.para_added_on) BETWEEN S_Date AND E_Date THEN
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   END) Para_added,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(v.setteled_on) BETWEEN S_Date AND E_Date AND
                          v.para_status != 8 AND v.com_stage IN (41, 45) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) Settled_com,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(v.setteled_on) BETWEEN S_Date AND E_Date AND
                          v.para_status != 8 AND v.com_stage NOT IN (41, 45) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) Settled_aud,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date AND
                          v.para_status = 8)) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) Outstanding,
               -- R1
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((v.audit_type = 'D' AND v.risk = '1' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date))) OR
                          (v.audit_type = 'B' AND v.annex_risk = '1' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date)))) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS R1,
               -- R2
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((v.audit_type = 'D' AND v.risk = '2' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date))) OR
                          (v.audit_type = 'B' AND v.annex_risk = '2' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date)))) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS R2,
               -- R3
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((v.audit_type = 'D' AND v.risk in ('3', 0) AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date))) OR
                          (v.audit_type = 'B' AND v.annex_risk = '3' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date)))) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS R3
          FROM V_RPT_FAD_MONTHLY_BASE v
         WHERE v.audited_by = ENT_ID
         GROUP BY v.p_name, v.entity_id, v.c_name
         ORDER BY v.p_name;
    ELSIF R_ID IN (43, 44) THEN
      OPEN io_cursor FOR
        SELECT v.p_name,
               v.entity_id AS child_code,
               v.c_name,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN (TRUNC(v.para_added_on) < S_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.setteled_on) >= S_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.para_added_on) < S_Date AND v.para_status = 8) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) opening_bal,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(v.para_added_on) BETWEEN S_Date AND E_Date THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) Para_added,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(v.setteled_on) BETWEEN S_Date AND E_Date AND
                          v.para_status != 8 AND v.com_stage IN (41, 45) THEN
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   END) Settled_com,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(v.setteled_on) BETWEEN S_Date AND E_Date AND
                          v.para_status != 8 AND v.com_stage NOT IN (41, 45) THEN
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   END) Settled_aud,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date AND
                          v.para_status = 8)) THEN
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   END) Outstanding,
               -- R1
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((v.audit_type = 'D' AND v.risk = '1' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date))) OR
                          (v.audit_type = 'B' AND v.annex_risk = '1' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date)))) THEN
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   END) AS R1,
               -- R2
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((v.audit_type = 'D' AND v.risk = '2' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date))) OR
                          (v.audit_type = 'B' AND v.annex_risk = '2' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date)))) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS R2,
               -- R3
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((v.audit_type = 'D' AND v.risk in (0, 3) AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date))) OR
                          (v.audit_type = 'B' AND v.annex_risk in ('0', '3') AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date)))) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS R3
          FROM V_RPT_FAD_MONTHLY_BASE v
         inner join t_auditee_entities e
            on e.entity_id = v.entity_id
         inner join v_get_compliance_reviewer_approver c
            on c.COM_KEY = e.complice_by
         WHERE c.ENTITY_ID = ENT_ID
           and v.autid = R_T
         GROUP BY v.p_name, v.entity_id, v.c_name
         ORDER BY v.p_name;
    ELSE
      OPEN io_cursor FOR
        SELECT v.p_name,
               v.entity_id AS child_code,
               v.c_name,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN (TRUNC(v.para_added_on) < S_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.setteled_on) >= S_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.para_added_on) < S_Date AND v.para_status = 8) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) opening_bal,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(v.para_added_on) BETWEEN S_Date AND E_Date THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) Para_added,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(v.setteled_on) BETWEEN S_Date AND E_Date AND
                          v.para_status != 8 AND v.com_stage IN (41, 45) THEN
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   END) Settled_com,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(v.setteled_on) BETWEEN S_Date AND E_Date AND
                          v.para_status != 8 AND v.com_stage NOT IN (41, 45) THEN
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   END) Settled_aud,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date AND
                          v.para_status = 8)) THEN
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   END) Outstanding,
               -- R1
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((v.audit_type = 'D' AND v.risk = '1' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date))) OR
                          (v.audit_type = 'B' AND v.annex_risk = '1' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date)))) THEN
                      1
                     else
                      0
                   END) AS R1,
               -- R2
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((v.audit_type = 'D' AND v.risk = '2' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date))) OR
                          (v.audit_type = 'B' AND v.annex_risk = '2' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date)))) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS R2,
               -- R3
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN ((v.audit_type = 'D' AND v.risk in (0, 3) AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date))) OR
                          (v.audit_type = 'B' AND v.annex_risk = '3' AND
                          ((v.para_status = 8 AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date) OR
                          (TRUNC(v.setteled_on) > E_Date AND
                          TRUNC(v.para_added_on) <= E_Date)))) THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS R3
          FROM V_RPT_FAD_MONTHLY_BASE v
         WHERE v.c_type_id = (CASE
                 WHEN R_T = -1 THEN
                  v.autid
                 ELSE
                  R_T
               END)
           AND v.audited_by = (CASE
                 WHEN R_ID IN (15, 16) THEN
                  ENT_ID
                 ELSE
                  v.audited_by
               END)
         GROUP BY v.p_name, v.entity_id, v.c_name
         ORDER BY v.p_name;
    END IF;
  END R_FAD_MONTHLY_REVIEW;

  Procedure P_GET_GM_WISE_SERIOUS_PARAS(P_NO      in number,
                                        ENT_ID    in number,
                                        R_ID      in number,
                                        R_T       in number,
                                        S_Date    in date,
                                        E_Date    in date,
                                        io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  
  begin
    if (R_ID in (15, 16)) then
      open io_cursor for
      
        SELECT gm.parent_id,
               gm.p_name,
               COUNT(CASE
                       WHEN TRUNC(c.entereddate) < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR') THEN
                        c.id
                     END) AS total_before_current_year,
               COUNT(CASE
                       WHEN TRUNC(c.entereddate) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR') THEN
                        c.id
                     END) AS total_in_current_year,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(c.entereddate) < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR') AND
                          c.annex = 1 THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS a1_before_current_year,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(c.entereddate) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR') AND
                          c.annex = 1 THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS a1_in_current_year,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(c.entereddate) < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR') AND
                          c.annex = 1 THEN
                      cast(cast(c.amount_involved as number) / 1000000 as
                           number(10, 3))
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS c_amount_before_current_year,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(c.entereddate) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR') AND
                          c.annex = 1 THEN
                      cast(cast(c.amount_involved as number) / 1000000 as
                           number(10, 3))
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS c_amount_in_current_year,
               sum(case
                     when r.O_PARA_ID = c.old_para_id then
                      r.NO_OF_EMP
                   end) AS per_inv,
               sum(case
                     when r.N_PARA_ID = c.new_paraid then
                      r.NO_OF_EMP
                   end) AS c_per_inv
          FROM t_auditee_entities_maping rg
         INNER JOIN t_auditee_entities_maping gm
            ON gm.entity_id = rg.parent_id
         INNER JOIN t_au_observation_fad c
            ON c.entity_id = rg.entity_id
         inner join V_GET_ANEX_NO_OF_RESPONSIBLE r
            on (r.O_PARA_ID = c.old_para_id or c.new_paraid = r.N_PARA_ID)
         WHERE c.r_id = 1
           AND c.para_status = 8
           and c.audited_by = ENT_ID
        --AND gm.parent_id NOT IN (112210, 112201, 112224)
         GROUP BY gm.parent_id, gm.p_name;
    else
      open io_cursor for
      
        SELECT gm.parent_id,
               gm.p_name,
               COUNT(CASE
                       WHEN TRUNC(c.entereddate) < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR') THEN
                        c.id
                     END) AS total_before_current_year,
               COUNT(CASE
                       WHEN TRUNC(c.entereddate) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR') THEN
                        c.id
                     END) AS total_in_current_year,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(c.entereddate) < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR') AND
                          c.annex = 1 THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS a1_before_current_year,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(c.entereddate) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR') AND
                          c.annex = 1 THEN
                      1
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS a1_in_current_year,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(c.entereddate) < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR') AND
                          c.annex = 1 THEN
                      cast(cast(c.amount_involved as number) / 1000000 as
                           number(10, 3))
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS c_amount_before_current_year,
               SUM(CASE
                     WHEN TRUNC(c.entereddate) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR') AND
                          c.annex = 1 THEN
                      cast(cast(c.amount_involved as number) / 1000000 as
                           number(10, 3))
                     ELSE
                      0
                   END) AS c_amount_in_current_year,
               sum(case
                     when r.O_PARA_ID = c.old_para_id then
                      r.NO_OF_EMP
                   end) AS per_inv,
               sum(case
                     when r.N_PARA_ID = c.new_paraid then
                      r.NO_OF_EMP
                   end) AS c_per_inv
          FROM t_auditee_entities_maping rg
         INNER JOIN t_auditee_entities_maping gm
            ON gm.entity_id = rg.parent_id
         INNER JOIN t_au_observation_fad c
            ON c.entity_id = rg.entity_id
         inner join V_GET_ANEX_NO_OF_RESPONSIBLE r
            on (r.O_PARA_ID = c.old_para_id or c.new_paraid = r.N_PARA_ID)
         WHERE c.r_id = 1
           AND c.para_status = 8
        -- AND gm.parent_id NOT IN (112210, 112201, 112224)
         GROUP BY gm.parent_id, gm.p_name
         order by gm.p_name;
    end if;
  
  end P_GET_GM_WISE_SERIOUS_PARAS;

  Procedure P_GET_GM_WISE_SERIOUS_PARAS_DETAILS(PARENT_ENT_ID in number,
                                                IND           in varchar2,
                                                P_ANNEX       in varchar2,
                                                P_NO          in number,
                                                ENT_ID        in number,
                                                R_ID          in number,
                                                
                                                io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  
  begin
  
    if (P_ANNEX = 'ALL') then
      if (IND = 'S') then
      
        open io_cursor for
          SELECT rg.p_name,
                 rg.c_name,
                 cp.audit_period,
                 cp.para_no,
                 aa.code           as heading,
                 r.description     as risk,
                 cp.gist_of_paras,
                 c.amount_involved
            FROM t_auditee_entities_maping rg
           INNER JOIN t_auditee_entities_maping gm
              ON gm.entity_id = rg.parent_id
           INNER JOIN t_au_observation_fad c
              ON c.entity_id = rg.entity_id
           inner join ais_t_au_post_compliance cp
              on cp.Old_Para_Id = C.old_para_id
           inner join t_risk r
              on r.r_id = cp.risk
           inner join t_audit_checklist_annexure aa
              on c.annex = aa.id
           inner join V_GET_ANEX_NO_OF_RESPONSIBLE r
              on (r.O_PARA_ID = c.old_para_id or c.new_paraid = r.N_PARA_ID)
           WHERE c.r_id = 1
             AND c.para_status = 8
             and TRUNC(c.entereddate) < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR')
             AND gm.parent_id IN (PARENT_ENT_ID)
          --AND gm.parent_id NOT IN (112210, 112201, 112224)
          ;
      else
        open io_cursor for
          SELECT rg.p_name,
                 rg.c_name,
                 c.audit_period,
                 c.para_no,
                 aa.code           as heading,
                 r.description     as risk,
                 c.gist_of_paras,
                 c.amount_involved
            FROM t_auditee_entities_maping rg
           INNER JOIN t_auditee_entities_maping gm
              ON gm.entity_id = rg.parent_id
           INNER JOIN t_au_observation_fad c
              ON c.entity_id = rg.entity_id
           inner join ais_t_au_post_compliance cp
              on cp.new_para_id = C.new_paraid
           inner join t_risk r
              on r.r_id = cp.risk
           inner join t_audit_checklist_annexure aa
              on c.annex = aa.id
           inner join V_GET_ANEX_NO_OF_RESPONSIBLE r
              on (r.O_PARA_ID = c.old_para_id or c.new_paraid = r.N_PARA_ID)
           WHERE c.r_id = 1
             AND c.para_status = 8
             and TRUNC(c.entereddate) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR')
             AND gm.parent_id IN (PARENT_ENT_ID)
          --AND gm.parent_id NOT IN (112210, 112201, 112224)
          ;
      end if;
    
    else
      if (IND = 'S') then
      
        open io_cursor for
          SELECT rg.p_name,
                 rg.c_name,
                 cp.audit_period,
                 cp.para_no,
                 aa.code           as heading,
                 r.description     as risk,
                 cp.gist_of_paras,
                 c.amount_involved
            FROM t_auditee_entities_maping rg
           INNER JOIN t_auditee_entities_maping gm
              ON gm.entity_id = rg.parent_id
           INNER JOIN t_au_observation_fad c
              ON c.entity_id = rg.entity_id
           inner join ais_t_au_post_compliance cp
              on cp.Old_Para_Id = C.old_para_id
           inner join t_risk r
              on r.r_id = cp.risk
           inner join t_audit_checklist_annexure aa
              on c.annex = aa.id
           inner join V_GET_ANEX_NO_OF_RESPONSIBLE r
              on (r.O_PARA_ID = c.old_para_id or c.new_paraid = r.N_PARA_ID)
           WHERE c.r_id = 1
             AND c.para_status = 8
             and c.annex = 1
             and TRUNC(c.entereddate) < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR')
             AND gm.parent_id IN (PARENT_ENT_ID)
          --AND gm.parent_id NOT IN (112210, 112201, 112224)
          ;
      else
        open io_cursor for
          SELECT rg.p_name,
                 rg.c_name,
                 cp.audit_period,
                 cp.para_no,
                 aa.code           as heading,
                 r.description     as risk,
                 cp.gist_of_paras,
                 c.amount_involved
            FROM t_auditee_entities_maping rg
           INNER JOIN t_auditee_entities_maping gm
              ON gm.entity_id = rg.parent_id
           INNER JOIN t_au_observation_fad c
              ON c.entity_id = rg.entity_id
           inner join ais_t_au_post_compliance cp
              on cp.new_para_id = C.new_paraid
           inner join t_risk r
              on r.r_id = cp.risk
           inner join t_audit_checklist_annexure aa
              on c.annex = aa.id
           inner join V_GET_ANEX_NO_OF_RESPONSIBLE r
              on (r.O_PARA_ID = c.old_para_id or c.new_paraid = r.N_PARA_ID)
           WHERE c.r_id = 1
             AND c.para_status = 8
             and c.annex = 1
             and TRUNC(c.entereddate) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YEAR')
             AND gm.parent_id IN (PARENT_ENT_ID)
          --AND gm.parent_id NOT IN (112210, 112201, 112224)
          ;
      end if;
    
    end if;
  end P_GET_GM_WISE_SERIOUS_PARAS_DETAILS;

  Procedure P_GET_YEAR_WISE_AUDIT_OUTSTANDING_PARAS(E_ID      in number,
                                                    P_NO      in number,
                                                    R_ID      in number,
                                                    ENT_ID    in number,
                                                    io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  
  begin
  
    open io_cursor for
    
      SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(c.audit_period, '[^0-9]', '')) AS audit_period,
             c.entity_id,
             COUNT(c.entity_id) AS Total_Paras,
             SUM(CASE
                   WHEN c.para_status in ('9', '6') THEN
                    1
                   ELSE
                    0
                 END) AS Settled_para,
             SUM(CASE
                   WHEN c.para_status = '8' THEN
                    1
                   ELSE
                    0
                 END) AS Un_Settled_para,
             SUM(CASE
                   WHEN c.r_id = '1' AND c.para_status = '8' THEN
                    1
                   ELSE
                    0
                 END) AS R1,
             SUM(CASE
                   WHEN c.r_id = '2' AND c.para_status = '8' THEN
                    1
                   ELSE
                    0
                 END) AS R2,
             SUM(CASE
                   WHEN c.r_id = '3' AND c.para_status = '8' THEN
                    1
                   ELSE
                    0
                 END) AS R3
        FROM T_AU_OBSERVATION_FAD c
       WHERE c.entity_id = E_ID
       GROUP BY TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(c.audit_period, '[^0-9]', '')),
                c.entity_id
       ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(c.audit_period, '[^0-9]', '')) ASC;
  
  end P_GET_YEAR_WISE_AUDIT_OUTSTANDING_PARAS;

  procedure P_GET_YEAR_WISE_AUDIT_OUTSTANDING_PARAS_DETAILS(E_ID      in number,
                                                            A_PERIOD  in number,
                                                            P_NO      in number,
                                                            R_ID      in number,
                                                            ENT_ID    in number,
                                                            io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  
  begin
  
    open io_cursor for
      select f.Old_para_ref  as ref_p,
             f.new_paraid    obs_id,
             r.description   as entity_name,
             f.gist_of_paras,
             f.para_no,
             f.audit_period,
             f.ind           as para_category
        from T_AU_OBSERVATION_FAD f
       inner join t_risk r
          on r.r_id = f.r_id
       WHERE f.entity_id = E_ID
         and TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.audit_period, '[^0-9]', '')) =
             A_PERIOD
         and f.para_status = 8
       order by f.para_no;
  
  end P_GET_YEAR_WISE_AUDIT_OUTSTANDING_PARAS_DETAILS;

where lower(t.text) like' || '''%' || v_1 || '%''' ||

   and t.para_status = 8';
    execute immediate v_text;

    where lower(t.text) like  '(%'||lower(v_1)||'%)'
    and e.period_id in (2,3) and o.status = 8;*/
  
    open io_cursor for
      select * from temp_table_for_like;
  end P_GET_PARA_TEXT_WORDS;

  Procedure P_GET_PARA_TEXT_WORDS_V2(T_TEXT    varchar2,
                                     io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
    v_1 varchar2(1000);
  
  begin
  
    v_1 := ltrim(rtrim(lower(t_text)));
  
    OPEN IO_CURSOR FOR
      SELECT et.name,
             m.p_name,
             m.c_name,
             t.audit_period,
             t.para_no,
             t.gist_of_paras,
             t.code as annex,
             t.text
        FROM VM_GET_ALL_PARA_TEXT t -- created materialized view and added index
       INNER JOIN T_AUDITEE_ENTITIES et
          ON et.entity_id = t.audited_by
       INNER JOIN T_AUDITEE_ENTITIES_MAPING m
          ON m.entity_id = t.entity_id
       WHERE CONTAINS(t.text, '%' || v_1 || '%') > 0
            
         AND t.audit_period IN (2022, 2023, 2024)
         AND t.para_status = 8;
    --index added to the materialized view
    /* CREATE INDEX text_index ON VM_GET_ALL_PARA_TEXT(text)
    INDEXTYPE IS CTXSYS.CONTEXT; */
  end P_GET_PARA_TEXT_WORDS_V2;

  Procedure P_GET_FAD_DESK_OFFICER_AUDIT_PERIODS(io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  
  begin
  
    OPEN IO_CURSOR FOR
      select distinct (f.audit_period)
        from ais_t_au_post_compliance f
       where f.audit_period is not null
       order by f.audit_period desc;
  
  end P_GET_FAD_DESK_OFFICER_AUDIT_PERIODS;

  Procedure P_GET_FAD_DESK_OFFICER_RPT_BY_PERIOD(startDate date,
                                                 endDate   date,
                                                 io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  
  begin
  
    OPEN IO_CURSOR FOR
      select c.com_id,
             c.audit_period,
             c.child_code,
             c.c_name,
             c.az,
             c.p_name,
             c.annex,
             c.gist_of_paras,
             c.para_no,
             c.no_of_instances,
             c.risk,
             c.amount,
             c.para_status
      
        from V_FAD_NAUMAN_RPT c
      
       where c.para_added_on between trunc(startDate) and trunc(endDate);
  
  end P_GET_FAD_DESK_OFFICER_RPT_BY_PERIOD;

  Procedure P_GetAllParasYear(io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  
  begin
  
    OPEN IO_CURSOR FOR
      select distinct (f.audit_period)
        from t_au_observation_fad f
       where f.audit_period is not null
       order by f.audit_period asc;
  
  end P_GetAllParasYear;

  Procedure P_GET_YEAR_WISE_ALL_PARAS(A_PERIOD  number,
                                      io_cursor OUT t_cursor) is
  
  begin
  
    OPEN IO_CURSOR FOR
      select c.audit_period,
             et.entitytypedesc as ENTITY_TYPE,
             m.p_name as reporting_office,
             e.name as entity_name,
             r.name as Audit_Zone,
             c.para_no,
             c.gist_of_paras,
             rk.description as RISK,
             c.annexure,
             c.amount_involved,
             c.no_of_instances,
             '' as func_resp,
             '' as entity_risk,
             (case
               when c.para_status in (6, 9) then
                'settle'
               else
                'un-settle'
             end) as PARA_STATUS
      
        from t_au_old_paras_fad c
       inner join t_auditee_entities e
          on e.entity_id = c.entity_id
       inner join t_auditee_entities_maping m
          on m.entity_id = e.entity_id
       inner join t_auditee_entities r
          on r.entity_id = c.audited_by
       inner join t_risk rk
          on rk.rating = c.risk
       inner join t_auditee_ent_types et
          on et.autid = e.type_id
      
       where c.audited_by in (select e.entity_id
                                from t_auditee_entities e
                               where e.type_id = 9)
            
         and c.audit_period = A_PERIOD
       order by c.audit_period desc;
  
  end P_GET_YEAR_WISE_ALL_PARAS;
